title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

Location: Brazil

Mode: Remote

Duration: 1 year of contract with possibility of extension


We are looking for talents in the AdOps Data Sharing team within its Performance Marketing group. This role will be the cornerstone of AdOps Data Sharing team focusing on how to use 1st and 3rd party platforms to build impactful datasets that meet the business goals.


This role will put to use your technical skills working with data technologies with a strong ability to understand the business impact of the data. AdOps is part of the Marketing Technology Operations Team and is focused on the enablement andmaintenance of Uber’s performance marketing data. The team is highly operational, technical, and analytical, responsible for setting up accurate tracking, spend ingestion and data sharing ETLs across all paid marketing ad network channels and campaigns.


Responsibilities

• Support AdOps as a specialist in the paid marketing tech space.

• Analyze marketing event data to propose platform improvements and enhance data management.

• Build data-sharing pipelines and integrations using tools such as SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Hive.

• Identify and optimize data sources while auditing data quality to improve campaign performance.

• Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to address dataset gaps and propose solutions.

• Validate technical implementations and ensure cross-functional alignment.

• Communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to guide requirements and data-sharing solutions.

• Work with vendor partners to ensure alignment with Uber’s goals.

• Troubleshoot issues by leveraging strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Take ownership of projects and demonstrate results in both collaborative and independent work.


Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in performance marketing tech, data analytics, technical solutions, or related roles.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, or a similar technical discipline.

• Strong quantitative skills and proficiency with SQL, Excel, Python, Hive, Spark, etc.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems such as JIRA or Asana.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in support or service desk roles.

• Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to non-technical partners.

• Basic understanding of app and web tracking data for performance marketing.

description:

Full-time — flexibility required (24/7 operations environment

title: System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior System Engineer III to join our Enterprise Monitoring team. In this role, you will be critical to the daily operations, maintenance, and optimization of our observability platforms—Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic —and will also support day-to-day ticketing and incident response workflows. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with a passion for automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities:

  • Own the daily health, performance, and availability of enterprise monitoring tools (Splunk, DynaTrace, NewRelic).
  • Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and configuration tuning to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Triage and resolve monitoring-related incidents and service tickets in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to integrate monitoring solutions and improve visibility.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and reports to support operational and business needs.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response efforts.
  • Document operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or enterprise monitoring roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of IT operations, incident management, and ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and tool integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and a bias for action in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a global or distributed team.
  • Knowledge of ITIL practices and observability maturity models.
  • Certifications in Splunk, DynaTrace, or NewRelic are a plus.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist – Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:
About Us

At Space Financial Group, we help entrepreneurs from the US, Latin America, Brazil, and worldwide set up and run U.S. companies the right way. We specialize in LLCs, S-Corps, tax compliance, bookkeeping, and Virtual CFO services for both foreign-owned U.S. entities and traditional American clients.

We’re growing fast and need an experienced, detail-oriented accounting and tax professional who loves solving complex cross-border puzzles and delivering peace of mind to clients.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file U.S. federal (and some state) tax returns for:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

- S-Corporations (Form 1120-S, K-1s)

- Foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entities and corporations (Form 5472, 1120)

- U.S. individual tax returns (Form 1040, 1040-NR for non-residents)

  • Manage monthly/quarterly bookkeeping and financial statement preparation using QuickBooks Online
  • Oversee payroll compliance when applicable
  • Advise clients (in Spanish, Portuguese, or English) on tax-saving strategies, entity structuring, BOI reporting (FinCEN), and compliance timelines
  • Review and correct client-provided records, flag red flags, and ensure data accuracy
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does


Compensation & Benefits

  • R$6,000 – R$9,000 BRL/month (depending on experience & certifications)
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Paid time off
  • Annual training/conference budget

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

  • Integration Procedure
  • Data Raptor
  • Omniscript
  • FlexCard
  • Calculation Matrices
  • Validation Rule
  • Flow

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: SAP SAC Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

Nice to Have Skills & Experience


- Experience with predictive planning and advanced analytics in SAC. - Familiarity with cloud architecture and security best practices.


Job Description


One of Insight Global's clients is seeking a skilled SAP SAC Developer to lead and support Reporting & Analytics initiatives. This role involves designing and developing SAC planning models, managing data processes, and collaborating with international business stakeholders to enhance decision-making capabilities. The role is fully remote, 4:30pm - 12:30am IST (6:00am - 1:00pm EST). title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software experience, including API and domain model design as well as JavaScript and Node.js development, to join our U.S. client's Platform Engineering team. Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our clients take the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy to a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their effectiveness against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires.   • Create data models using RDBMS principles and implement them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications

  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você fará parte do time que atende uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , contribuindo em iniciativas estratégicas com foco em métricas, governança de dados e apoio à tomada de decisão.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para suporte a indicadores de negócio.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados utilizando DAX e Power Query (M).
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes como Excel, Smartsheet, SQL Server, SharePoint e Azure.
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados utilizados nas soluções de BI.
  • Levantar requisitos com stakeholders e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Documentar regras de negócio, fontes de dados e padrões de modelagem.
  • Apoiar usuários com treinamento e habilitação para autosserviço.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias contínuas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas funcionalidades e boas práticas em Power BI.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Power BI
  • Proficiência em DAX, Power Query (M) e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com SQL e bancos relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Warehouse e ETL.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e alinhamento com áreas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas em um ambiente dinâmico.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com serviços de dados Azure (como Azure SQL e Data Factory).
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos e times multifuncionais.
  • Experiência em storytelling com dados ou governança de dados.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
We’re currently looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our network engineering team supporting a global technology project.

In this position, you’ll be responsible for executing and implementing network configurations on Arista and Cisco devices, based on pre-defined scripts and configurations. You’ll work closely with U.S.-based teams to ensure the successful deployment and support of enterprise network infrastructure.

This role is hands-on and ideal for engineers with a strong foundation in networking , Ansible automation , and Cisco systems , who enjoy problem-solving and ensuring reliable network operations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute existing Arista configurations and perform hands-on implementation tasks.
  • Run and monitor Ansible scripts , identifying and troubleshooting execution issues.
  • Implement configuration changes in line with project governance.
  • Participate in network deployment projects, ensuring accurate documentation and adherence to standards.
  • Support and maintain existing routing and switching infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus and Arista CVP environments.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders to coordinate installations and surveys.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, and switching issues (BGP, EIGRP, ACLs, VLANs, spanning tree, etc.).
  • Provide post-deployment support and perform peer reviews of configuration documentation.


Requirements

  • Extensive knowledge of Cisco IOS Platforms and Cisco Systems products.
  • Experience performing LAN/WAN hardware infrastructure changes
  • Knowledge of ST, SC, and LC fiber optic technologies
  • Knowledge of LAN infrastructure to include Cisco Switches and Routers
  • Knowledge of LAN switch configuration technologies to include VTP, STP, QoS, and Cisco switch stack configurations
  • Knowledge of Routing Protocols and Routing Redistribution
  • In-depth understanding of troubleshooting Cisco router and switch configurations.
  • Ability to interface directly with vendors and local support teams regarding WAN/LAN hardware implementation
  • Ability to self-manage concurrently running projects.
  • Ability to follow Change Management Processes
  • Ability to work during nights, weekends, and during the daytime
  • 5+ years of experience in network implementation and operations (10+ years preferred).
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Experience with Arista Devices and WAAS devices is a plus.
  • Availability to work during U.S. business hours and occasionally on weekends for deployments.


Preferred Certifications

  • CCNA / CCNP (required or in progress).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science , or related field (preferred).

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
We are hiring!

Please find the job description below. If you're interested, I would appreciate it if you could share your updated resume with me.


Role: SAP SD Consultant

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Full Time


Required To Travel once a Month to the work Location at Alagoinhas, Bahia (manufacturing plant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.
  • Localization expertise:
  • Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.
  • Tax and compliance:
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.
  • Integration:
  • Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.
  • Technical collaboration:
  • Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).
  • Project and change management:
  • Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.
  • Support:
  • Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.

Required skills and experience:

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile along with a short note on why this role aligns with your experience and interests. title: Gestor(a) Produção Agrícola
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Produção Agrícola para atuar no nosso time de Produção Agrícola.


Quais as responsabilidades?

Comandar a programação diária das atividades para o dia seguinte, alocando as turmas nas atividades de forma a obter o melhor desempenho de cada uma delas, controlar e qualificar a operação de corte manual e colheita mecanizada, sob a ótica da impureza vegetal e mineral;

Estruturar o acompanhamento do desenvolvimento vegetativo e, no caso de alguma ocorrência que venha afetar a cultura, o mesmo reportar à gerência para definir ações de controle e programar diariamente as atividades das locações das turmas para melhor desempenho;

Elaborar preço para o corte de cana, estimando por metro de cana cortada, fazendo a conversão de tonelada para metro, elaborando a coleta diária dos apontamentos de campo, cumprindo os prazos para o fechamento de vencimentos;

Organizar a entrega dos Informes diários de operações, esclarecendo diariamente a locação, quantidade de pessoas e previsão de rendimento operacional;

Supervisionar a aplicação do sistema da qualidade em sua área, implementando em parceria com a Áreade Qualidade, buscando a manutenção das certificações e cumprindo os requisitos, realizando auditorias internas e externas, executando a qualificação de fornecedores e garantindo a qualidade em todas as operações sob sua responsabilidade;

Gerir os recursos humanos da área garantindo que todas as políticas, técnicas e procedimentos sejam cumpridas, manter a equipe motivada por meio de um relacionamento saudável, visando a retenção da MO e gerar expectativa de crescimento na carreira, suprir todas as necessidades sejam técnicas ou operacionais através de treinamentos específicos;

Supervisionar a qualificação e dar condições para que a mão de obra desempenhe as atividades de forma satisfatória no rendimento operacional de plantio e colheita.


Quais os requisitos?

Ensino superior completo em agronomia ou áreas afins;

Sólida vivência em estimativa de produção agrícola, formação de lavoura e variedades de cana;

Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;

Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão da rotina, planejamento e orçamento;

Residir na região de Olímpia/SP.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Analista de Marketing (Engenharia Civil e Arquitetura)
description:
About the job


Este é um cargo remoto.


A oportunidade


A indústria da construção civil é a segunda menos digitalizada globalmente, e a Vobi nasceu para revolucioná-la! Nossa missão é empoderar profissionais e pequenos negócios deste setor, conectando toda a indústria em uma única plataforma e fornecendo-lhes todas as ferramentas necessárias para entregarem projetos e obras incríveis de maneira transparente, simples e colaborativa.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Marketing Júnior para fortalecer o nosso time. Procuramos alguém curioso, criativo, analítico e adaptável, que entenda a rotina e os desafios do nosso público (arquitetos, engenheiros e construtores) e que queira crescer junto com a Vobi.


Se você gosta de desafios, aprende rápido e tem vontade de colocar a mão na massa, essa vaga é para você!


Atividades


  • Ser parte ativa nas ações de construção da marca, visando fortalecer a imagem da empresa;
  • Participar na criação de campanhas de mídia paga e mídias sociais;
  • Contribuir com pautas editoriais, criação de roteiros de websérie e anúncios;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de Vendas para identificar oportunidades de aquisição e conversão de novos clientes;
  • Criar e otimizar conteúdos estratégicos para SEO (artigos, blogs, landing pages e muito mais);
  • Coletar métricas e elaborar relatórios, gerar insights e hipóteses sobre os KPIs de marketing;

    • Requisitos


    O que esperamos de você


    • Formação ou vivência em Arquitetura e Engenharia Civil;
    • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal;
    • Criatividade para propor novas ideias e estratégias;
    • Perfil investigativo e curioso para solucionar problemas;
    • Forte pensamento crítico e analítico;
    • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel/Google Sheets;
    • Experiência com Marketing Digital (diferencial);
    • Experiência com construção civil (diferencial);

    • Benefícios


    Porque você vai amar trabalhar com a gente


    • Remuneração competitiva em relação ao mercado;
    • Possibilidade de participação societária;
    • Ambiente descontraído, com muitas oportunidades de crescimento e suporte para desenvolver sua carreira;
    • Happy Hours mensais e confraternizações presenciais semestrais;
    • Gympass;
    • Day off de aniversário;
    • Trabalho remoto e flexível;
    • Liberdade para propor novas ideias e assumir grandes responsabilidades.

    • Sobre a Vobi

title: Senior Data Science Analyst
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Senior Data Science Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Data Plataform.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning utilizando técnicas de classificação, regressão e clusterização;
  • Realizar testes de modelos de machine learning, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, testes A/B, testes de hipótese e validação cruzada;
  • Proficiente em feature engineering para otimizar os desempenhos dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning em cima da plataforma databricks;
  • Manutenção de modelos existentes (Acompanhamento e eventuais retreinamentos) ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências relevantes;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de práticas de MLOps..

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Machine Learning | Regressão, Classificação, Clusterização, Redes Neurais, Seleção de Features, Cross-Validation, "Curse of Dimensionality", Viés-Variânica, Explicabilidade de Modelos, etc;
  • Estatística Avançada | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, desing experimental, modelagem preditiva, otimização, testes de hipótese, regressão, modelagem e métodos;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar scrips e queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Modelagem Estatística & Advanced Analytics | NLP, Séries Temporais, Random Forests, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Clustering methods (e.g. K-means), Classification methods (Decision Trees/Random Forest), among others;
  • MLOps básico | para entender os desafios de se colocar um modelo em produção;
  • Experimentação | Testes A|B, Hipóteses, Modelos de Atribuição;
  • Grandes Volumes | Extrair e manipular grandes bases de dados, utilizando a stack de dados disponível.


FERRAMENTAS

  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Python ou R | Pra quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala, Java & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Teste de Hipóteses | Para suportar o processo de tomada de decisão e criar informação de suporte;
  • Databricks | Uso de clusters e workspaces para BigData.


O que oferecemos

title: Back End Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract: 12/01/2025 to 02/28/2026 (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Order Pricing team, responsible for building and enhancing the Pricing applications that define, manage, and apply promotions across the shopping experience. This role focuses on developing high-performance backend systems that ensure accurate, real-time pricing and promotion application to shopping bags.

Consultant will play a key role in designing scalable microservices, implementing event-driven architecture, and driving continuous delivery in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Backend System Design & Development: Architect, develop, and maintain microservices in Java and Spring Boot to support pricing, promotions setup, and calculation logic.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Design and maintain asynchronous data flows using Apache Kafka for high throughput and reliability in real-time promotion processing.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment: Build and deploy services on Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, resilience, and observability across environments.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Develop and maintain automated build and deploy pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and Argo CD, ensuring fast, reliable, and secure delivery.
  • Performance & Reliability: Optimize services for high performance and low latency, including caching strategies, database tuning, and message processing efficiency.
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Implement observability and operational monitoring using GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana to ensure system health, proactive alerting, and incident response.


Requirements:

  • Experience: 6–10 years of professional experience in backend software development, preferably within e-commerce, retail, or pricing systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Java 11+ and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
  • Proven experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, topics, schema registry, error handling, and message tracing).
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on Kubernetes.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and ArgoCD
  • Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching (Redis).
  • Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Azure.
  • Experience with GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana for monitoring, alerting, and incident management.
  • Understanding of distributed tracing and log correlation best practices.

title: LLM Engineer
description:
Our client, an international AI development company based in New York, is currently seeking a "LLM Engineer " to lead strategic product development efforts in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.


This role will focus on implementing scalable vector store integrations, building retrieval pipelines, and enabling advanced communication protocols between intelligent agents.

Key Responsibilities

RAG & VectorStore Systems:

Build and maintain end-to-end RAG pipelines for context-augmented generation

Integrate and optimize vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus)

Support the engineering backbone of agentic and RAG-based AI systems

Protocol Engineering:

Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) to maintain stateful LLM interactions

Build Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication layers for multi-agent orchestration

Enable persistent memory and context sharing across model calls

Platform Enablement:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to productionize models and workflows

Ensure seamless data flow and model integration across services

Qualifications & Skills

Deep experience with vector databases and RAG architecture

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) design patterns

Solid background in Python, cloud-based ML pipelines, and containerization tools

Experience in operationalizing LLM-based systems in production

Detail-oriented with a strong engineering mindset

Effective communicator with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Self-driven and adaptable in a fast-paced R&D environment

Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal (essential for global collaboration)

Experience with Contract Analysis and automated document understanding

Nice to Have:

Experience with invoice parsing / invoice understanding, including extracting structured data from financial documents

Experience in NLP-to-SQL, natural language querying, or generating structured database queries from unstructured text

Familiarity with legal-tech, document intelligence, or enterprise knowledge extraction systems

Experience with observability, vector hygiene, and evaluation frameworks for RAG/agentic systems

Hands-on work with high-throughput, low-latency AI pipelines

title: Gestor(a) Produção Agrícola
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Produção Agrícola para atuar no nosso time de Produção Agrícola.


Quais as responsabilidades?

Comandar a programação diária das atividades para o dia seguinte, alocando as turmas nas atividades de forma a obter o melhor desempenho de cada uma delas, controlar e qualificar a operação de corte manual e colheita mecanizada, sob a ótica da impureza vegetal e mineral;

Estruturar o acompanhamento do desenvolvimento vegetativo e, no caso de alguma ocorrência que venha afetar a cultura, o mesmo reportar à gerência para definir ações de controle e programar diariamente as atividades das locações das turmas para melhor desempenho;

Elaborar preço para o corte de cana, estimando por metro de cana cortada, fazendo a conversão de tonelada para metro, elaborando a coleta diária dos apontamentos de campo, cumprindo os prazos para o fechamento de vencimentos;

Organizar a entrega dos Informes diários de operações, esclarecendo diariamente a locação, quantidade de pessoas e previsão de rendimento operacional;

Supervisionar a aplicação do sistema da qualidade em sua área, implementando em parceria com a Áreade Qualidade, buscando a manutenção das certificações e cumprindo os requisitos, realizando auditorias internas e externas, executando a qualificação de fornecedores e garantindo a qualidade em todas as operações sob sua responsabilidade;

Gerir os recursos humanos da área garantindo que todas as políticas, técnicas e procedimentos sejam cumpridas, manter a equipe motivada por meio de um relacionamento saudável, visando a retenção da MO e gerar expectativa de crescimento na carreira, suprir todas as necessidades sejam técnicas ou operacionais através de treinamentos específicos;

Supervisionar a qualificação e dar condições para que a mão de obra desempenhe as atividades de forma satisfatória no rendimento operacional de plantio e colheita.


Quais os requisitos?

Ensino superior completo em agronomia ou áreas afins;

Sólida vivência em estimativa de produção agrícola, formação de lavoura e variedades de cana;

Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;

Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão da rotina, planejamento e orçamento;

Residir na região de Olímpia/SP.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)

Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe criar conexões autênticas e tem talento para transformar conversas em resultados?

Busca crescimento constante e quer atuar com grandes experts do mercado?

Então essa vaga é para você!



Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento genuíno.

Estamos em busca de um Social Seller para atuar no Instagram, ajudando a converter seguidores em clientes e impulsionar o faturamento de grandes nomes do digital.

O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é o profissional responsável por vendas sociais , construindo e nutrindo relacionamentos com potenciais clientes por meio das redes sociais (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, interagindo estrategicamente com o público para gerar vendas e novas oportunidades de negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram

  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar interações no CRM (Kommo) com precisão
  • Realizar follow-ups inteligentes para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de desempenho e indicadores

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência prévia em vendas (de preferência no digital: infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Comunicação clara, persuasiva e empática
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Comprometimento com metas, foco em resultados e mentalidade de crescimento
  • Dispositivos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)


O que oferecemos

  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe de acordo com sua performance)

title: Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist (LATAM) — Remote
description:
Join GrowthAssistant as a Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist!

Open to candidates from LATAM countries only (e.g., Mexico, Brazil, Colombia)


About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist to support our client’s Paid Media team. You’ll ensure every digital advertising campaign is tracked accurately and consistently, building and maintaining the infrastructure behind performance measurement. This includes configuring, QA’ing, and troubleshooting tracking systems—mainly via Google Tag Manager (GTM)—to ensure data integrity and accurate attribution.


By partnering closely with Paid Search Specialists and Account Strategists, you’ll help eliminate inaccurate conversion data, improve ROI reporting, and enable smarter optimization decisions across 60+ client accounts.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Implement, QA, and maintain tags, triggers, and pixels in Google Tag Manager (GTM) across client websites.
  • Audit and troubleshoot conversion tracking configurations across platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads).
  • Validate conversion actions to ensure form fills, purchases, or other lead events are correctly recorded, avoiding inflated reporting.
  • Standardize and document tagging schemas for all client accounts in Salesforce, ensuring consistent fields (budget, KPIs, goals, tracking status).
  • Partner with Paid Search Specialists to align conversion actions and budgets with each client’s true business objectives.
  • Create and maintain a tracking QA checklist and intake form to guide new account setups and audits.
  • Perform ongoing health checks of all tracking infrastructure to proactively identify broken tags or discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the client’s marketing team to recommend scalable intake and QA processes (e.g., onboarding forms, Salesforce automation).
  • Produce clear documentation for all tagging and data validation processes to ensure team-wide continuity.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience managing Google Tag Manager (tag creation, testing, triggers, version control).
  • Solid understanding of conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid media platforms.
  • Hands-on experience validating data layers, debugging tags, and testing event triggers in browser consoles.
  • Strong ability to QA campaign tracking and identify discrepancies between actual and reported performance data.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or maintaining documentation (SOPs, QA templates, checklists).
  • Excellent communication skills to partner with account managers, strategists, and technical teams.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems for marketing data management.
  • Understanding of enhanced conversions, consent mode, and privacy-related tagging.
  • Exposure to GA4 or other analytics platforms for event-based measurement.
  • Experience supporting agencies managing high-volume client portfolios.
  • Prior experience collaborating with web developers or marketing analysts on data validation and tag troubleshooting.


Durable Skills

  • Highly detail-oriented, precise, and methodical in QA and documentation.
  • Process-driven mindset—capable of building repeatable tagging and validation frameworks.
  • Problem-solving mentality with a focus on scalable solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ownership mentality with a focus on accuracy, quality, and reliability.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Desenvolvedor Outsystem
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Cliente global de tecnologia, com presença no Brasil e em diversos setores industriais. Esta vaga está sendo divulgada como banco de talentos para uma demanda prevista para os próximos meses.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações utilizando a plataforma OutSystems
  • Participar do desenho da solução e modelagem de dados conforme padrões da plataforma
  • Implementar integrações com APIs, serviços externos e sistemas corporativos
  • Atuar em squads ágeis em parceria com times de produto, negócio e QA
  • Realizar testes, validações técnicas, correções e melhorias contínuas nas aplicações
  • Garantir conformidade com boas práticas, governança e padrões arquiteturais
  • Apoiar revisões técnicas, documentação e evolução do ciclo de vida da aplicação

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações OutSystems
  • Conhecimento em integrações (REST, SOAP, APIs e serviços internos)
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de software web/mobile
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares)
  • Autonomia para execução técnica (nível pleno ou superior)
  • Idioma: inglês poderá ser exigido dependendo do projeto. Ter inglês é um diferencial e será considerado na priorização conforme a demanda.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Certificações OutSystems (Associate, Professional, Specialist)
  • Experiência em arquitetura, componentes reutilizáveis e governança
  • Atuação em projetos globais ou times internacionais
  • Conhecimento em .NET, C#, SQL, front-end ou microserviços
  • Vivência com Azure, CI/CD, DevOps ou automação
  • Experiência em liderança técnica, mentoria ou suporte a outros devs
  • Inglês para conversação, reuniões e documentação técnica
  • Comunicação clara, colaboração e orientação à solução
  • Capacidade analítica e postura consultiva frente ao negócio

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office
