Profissionais da área comercial com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para congressos e feiras. Podem estar baseados no México, Colômbia, Brasil, Argentina, Uruguai, Panamá ou Miami, Estados Unidos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades e funções?

  • Conduzir o processo integral de vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para nossos congressos e feiras, estabelecendo conexões diretas com C-Levels (Country Managers, Diretores de Vendas, Marketing) das 2000 principais empresas tecnológicas globais e locais.
  • Superar metas de vendas, com foco em garantir patrocínios das principais empresas de tecnologia para nossos congressos e feiras.
  • Gerenciar e cultivar relações sólidas com clientes existentes, garantindo uma experiência contínua e satisfatória.
  • Implementar estratégias para assegurar a retenção e renovação de contas-chave na carteira, transformando clientes em contas estratégicas, ampliando negócios por meio de upselling e cross-selling.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento nas contas atribuídas, antecipando e atendendo às necessidades em constante mudança dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos e estratégias para ampliar a participação e maximizar o valor de cada conta.
  • Explorar ativamente novas oportunidades de negócios, identificando clientes potenciais e setores estratégicos.


Requisitos

  • Capacidade comprovada de vender e negociar em inglês.
  • Perfil hunter, com habilidades de prospecção, busca ativa de oportunidades, proatividade, autonomia, resiliência, aprendizado rápido e forte orientação para resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, além de sólidas competências de negociação.
  • Disponibilidade e recursos para trabalhar em tempo integral no modelo home office.
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de intangíveis, patrocínios, sponsorships, estandes.
  • Experiência em negociação com executivos C-Levels, VPs e gerentes de marketing regionais de grandes empresas tecnológicas da região e globais.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado em CRM, Microsoft Office e softwares de produtividade em vendas.


O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário base competitivo + as melhores comissões do mercado.
  • Cultura de trabalho colaborativa, ambiente multicultural com profissionais de diferentes países.
  • Fazer parte de uma empresa em constante crescimento.
  • Colaborar e aprender junto a profissionais e especialistas renomados.
  • Estar na vanguarda dos processos de vendas B2B e negociação.


Sobre nós

Através dos nossos congressos no Chile, México e Estados Unidos ( somos o ponto de encontro entre fornecedores globais e locais de soluções tecnológicas em Inteligência Artificial, Cloud, Big Data, IoT, Indústria 4.0, Telecomunicações, Software, Fintech, Web3, e-commerce, Marketing Digital e CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CMOs, CDOs, CISOs, CFOs, líderes de negócios, inovação e transformação digital de operadoras, bancos, varejo, indústrias (manufatura, energia, petróleo e gás, mineração, agroindústria, utilities) e autoridades governamentais, ajudando-os a acelerar sua transformação digital e a migrar a economia dos países para uma economia digital.

Através do America Digital News TV ( somos o principal canal de TV e mídia online focado em notícias nas áreas de Inteligência Artificial, Inovação, Tecnologia, Negócios e Transformação Digital, alcançando atualmente mais de 145.000 assinantes.


Nossa missão

Através dos nossos congressos e meio online, ser o maior ecossistema de networking, capacitação e informação nas áreas de IA, Tecnologia, Transformação Digital e Negócios.

  • Qual é o seu nível de domínio do Microsoft Office e CRMs? Quais CRMs já utilizou? Classifique de 1 a 7.

  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).


Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

title: Business Development Manager Sustainability
description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Data Cloud Consultant

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


1. Backend & API Development

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com FastAPI (Python).

  • Escrever SQL de forma eficiente para extração e transformação de dados (experiência apenas com ORM não atende).
  • Implementar autenticação via JWT e RBAC para garantir segurança dos endpoints.
  • Trabalhar com times de frontend e produto para definir modelos, esquemas e endpoints.

  • Automatizar pipelines de build, teste e deploy, mantendo padrões de qualidade e segurança.
  • Fazer deploy em Azure Cloud, garantindo consistência entre Test, UAT e Production.


4. Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Criar testes automatizados com Pytest e garantir execução no pipeline de CI.

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

description:

Who we are:


Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).


About the Role


We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , NodeJS backend development , and experience scripting within NetSuite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.


Responsibilities


  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , QuickBooks Online , and Salesforce .
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.


Requirements:


  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .


Nice to Have


  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • Background in ERP systems or business process automation.
  • Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.

title: Senior Consultant - Treasury (Brazil)
description:
Senior Consultant - Treasury, Financial Transactions & Accounting


Fully remote position offering a flexible work schedule.

Location: LATAM (Brazil)


You’ll work with top-tier clients across industries - multinationals, banks, and government entities. You're not just executing tasks, you’re leading workstreams, shaping recommendations, and driving change in treasury organizations.


About us:

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.


Job description:

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in financial transactions, treasury management systems, and accounting advisory. In this role, you will advise clients on optimizing their treasury operations, cash management, and transaction accounting processes, while ensuring compliance with IFRS/US GAAP and best practices. You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.


Required Skills:

• Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

• Provide technical expertise on treasury-related accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated consulting solutions.

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.


Desired Skills:

CFA, CPA, or CTP certification is preferred

English: Able to communicate fluently, you will work with a multicultural team and consultants from other countries.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re a fast-growing consumer brand group selling across e-commerce, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. We prioritize direct-response strategy, product quality, and measurable efficacy. The team moves fast and operates with a high bar.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.


You’ll own both strategy and ops: building and briefing angles, scripting iterations, managing sprints, reviewing edits, and ensuring we ship 100–200 ads per week.


You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

● Familiarity with tools: ClickUp/Asana, Frame.io, Motion/Varos, Google Workspace, CapCut/Descript, Runway/Topaz/ElevenLabs

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing
description:
Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Visão Geral da Posição

O Consultor de Ativação de Marketing é responsável por configurar e executar campanhas de CRM e Loyalty no Salesforce Marketing Cloud , transformando estratégias de jornada em ações concretas por meio do uso avançado das funcionalidades da plataforma. Este cargo ativa jornadas de consumidor multi-etapas e multi-canais , aplicando regras de negócio, lógica de personalização e táticas de canal para entregar mensagens relevantes em grande escala.

Embora não seja responsável pelo desenvolvimento de backend ou automações técnicas , o profissional utiliza ferramentas nativas da plataforma (ex.: Journey Builder, Send Flows, Entry Criteria, Wait Steps, etc.) para executar campanhas de forma eficiente e precisa — sem necessidade de código . É necessário ter forte fluência nas capacidades de ativação self-service e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com leads de audiência, conteúdo e QA para garantir que todos os componentes estejam devidamente integrados.

Como especialista prático na configuração de jornadas e implantação de campanhas , este cargo permite que as marcas do setor entreguem comunicações consistentes, pontuais e de alto impacto via e-mail, push e outros canais próprios.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Direção de Marketing & Ativação

  • Traduzir estratégias de CRM e Loyalty em jornadas multi-etapas usando ferramentas self-service nativas da plataforma (ex.: funcionalidades drag & drop do SFMC).
  • Construir e lançar jornadas em E-mail, Push e SMS , incorporando lógica como wait steps, decision splits e regras de personalização baseadas nos objetivos da campanha.
  • Validar se todos os inputs necessários (ex.: audiências, templates, links, textos legais) estão completos e funcionais antes da ativação.
  • Monitorar jornadas ao vivo para detectar problemas de performance ou sinais operacionais (ex.: erros de audiência, falhas de lógica) e executar ajustes em tempo real quando necessário para garantir a integridade da execução .

Dados, Métricas & Otimização

  • Garantir a implementação correta da lógica de segmentação, critérios de entrada, tempos de espera e limites de frequência , alinhada à estratégia.
  • Marcar jornadas com IDs de campanha, metadados e parâmetros de rastreamento para suportar relatórios precisos.
  • Colaborar com o Analista de Performance & Insights para compartilhar observações da plataforma e validar os resultados das campanhas pós-lançamento.

Otimização de Processos de Campanha

  • Identificar lógicas repetitivas entre campanhas e propor estruturas modulares de jornada para aumentar a eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Manter documentação de melhores práticas de configuração de jornadas, checklists de QA de ativação e evolução dos padrões de execução.


Experiência e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em operações de CRM, ativação de campanhas ou marketing de ciclo de vida, preferencialmente em organizações grandes e multi-mercado .
  • Experiência prática em lançamento e gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ESPs equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento funcional profundo de módulos da plataforma: Journey Builder, Email Studio, Mobile Studio e Automation Studio .
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir estratégia em jornadas , utilizando wait steps, decision splits, filtros e lógica de conteúdo dinâmico .
  • Experiência em gerenciar calendários de campanhas complexos , com habilidade para lidar com várias ativações simultâneas em diferentes canais .
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , identificando e resolvendo problemas de configuração, falhas ou anomalias de performance de forma independente.
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes, orientação a processos e compromisso com a entrega impecável de campanhas .
  • Excelentes habilidades de colaboração para trabalhar com equipes de audiência, conteúdo, QA e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento em todas as camadas de execução.


Qualificações:

  • Certificações Salesforce Marketing Cloud (ex.: Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Administrator ) são desejáveis.
  • Experiência em ativação de programas de loyalty, design de jornadas de ciclo de vida do cliente ou personalização em escala .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de QA de campanha e auditorias de execução .
  • Compreensão da lógica de dados (ex.: critérios de entrada, filtros de segmentação, lógica de exclusão) de um ponto de vista funcional, não de desenvolvimento .
  • Experiência em marketing digital, operações de marketing ou CRM em setores como CPG, varejo ou engajamento de consumidores em grande volume .


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Role Overview

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects within scope, time, and budget constraints. This role focuses on managing cross-functional teams, ensuring stakeholder alignment, and driving operational excellence across diverse business initiatives. Unlike senior Program Managers, this position emphasizes hands-on project execution rather than portfolio-level strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Project Planning & Execution
  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor progress and adjust schedules as needed to meet deadlines.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational project management methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project updates.
  • Prepare and present status reports to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Risk & Issue Management
  • Identify potential risks early and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Escalate critical issues promptly to leadership.
  • Budget & Resource Management
  • Track project budgets and ensure cost-effective delivery.
  • Coordinate with resource managers for staffing needs.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Maintain compliance with internal standards and client expectations.
  • Conduct post-project reviews and implement lessons learned.


✅ Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, or related field.
  • PMP certification preferred (or equivalent like PRINCE2).
  • Project management experience in IT or business domains.
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile).
  • Proficiency in tools like MS Project, JIRA, Confluence.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior
description:
Vaga homeoffice - mas para profissionais de São Paulo ou Curitiba, pois pode ser necessário atuação presencial em alguns eventos.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior , com domínio técnico sólido em ambiente Azure e forte capacidade de atuação estratégica junto a áreas de negócio e liderança executiva.

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de dados robustas e escaláveis , atuar de forma consultiva com diferentes áreas da companhia, além de ser um ponto de apoio técnico e estratégico para o time de dados.

  • Compreender as dificuldades e desafios do negócio , propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Domínio avançado em Azure , com forte experiência em ADF, Synapse e Databricks .
  • Conhecimento profundo em PySpark .
  • Experiência em integração entre tecnologias de dados e desenho de arquitetura de dados .
  • Habilidade para realizar code review e garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa e consultiva com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar fora do horário padrão , quando necessário.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade, proatividade e resiliência — o profissional será bastante desafiado e exigido tecnicamente.
  • Excelente comunicação , com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para executivos e diretores.
  • Experiência em reuniões com alta liderança e na elaboração de apresentações executivas .

Desejável

  • Conhecimento em Python , Spark , SQL .
  • Experiência com EventHubs ou Kafka .
  • Familiaridade com DevOps , Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning (ML) .
  • Experiência ou entendimento em Governança de Dados .

Perfil Comportamental

  • Proatividade e senso de dono , atuando com autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Resiliência e equilíbrio emocional frente a demandas complexas e prazos desafiadores.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para transitar entre áreas técnicas e executivas.
  • Espírito colaborativo e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior – Kotlin/Java + ReactJS
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior para atuar em um projeto temporário (contrato de 3 a 4 meses) , com foco em Kotlin/Java (Spring Boot) no backend e ReactJS no frontend.

Você fará parte de um time técnico de alta performance, responsável por evoluir plataformas escaláveis e de grande impacto, contribuindo tanto na arquitetura e desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços quanto na construção de interfaces ricas e intuitivas para o usuário final.

O perfil ideal é alguém que une sólido conhecimento técnico em engenharia de software com visão de produto, boa comunicação e postura colaborativa, capaz de transitar entre camadas da aplicação com fluidez.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações fullstack , com backend em Kotlin/Java (Spring Boot) e frontend em ReactJS .
  • Participar ativamente do desenho e implementação de arquiteturas escaláveis e evolutivas .
  • Criar e manter APIs GraphQL (principal) e REST , assegurando desempenho e segurança.
  • Projetar e implementar comunicação entre microsserviços utilizando gRPC .
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e eficiente , aplicando princípios de engenharia de software.
  • Garantir qualidade de software através de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e E2E).
  • Apoiar revisões de código e disseminar boas práticas no time.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de produto e design para alinhar soluções à melhor experiência do usuário.
  • Investigar novas tecnologias e propor melhorias contínuas.


Essenciais (ênfase da vaga):

  • Experiência sólida em Kotlin e/ou Java com Spring Boot .
  • Forte base em desenvolvimento frontend com ReactJS , incluindo Hooks , Context API , TypeScript e consumo de APIs GraphQL/REST .
  • Domínio de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, Clean Architecture).
  • Cultura de testes automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Testing Library).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL) e não-relacionais (MongoDB, Redis) .
  • Vivência em Git , CI/CD pipelines e deploys em ambientes Kubernetes (AWS ou similar) .


Importantes (secundários, mas valorizados):

  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos .
  • Experiência com mensageria e filas (Kafka, SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento de componentização e arquitetura microfrontend no frontend.
  • Familiaridade com Node.js


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de grande escala e ambientes de alta disponibilidade .
  • Atuação prévia em times ágeis com práticas de DevOps .


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

  • Forte experiência prática em SAP SD Order-to-Cash: documentos de vendas (consulta/cotação/pedido de venda/devoluções), entrega/PGI, faturamento (F2/G2/notas de crédito/débito/cancelamento) e devoluções/reembolsos.

  • Experiência completa no ciclo de vida: requisitos, design/configuração, especificações RICEF, testes unitários/SIT/UAT, transição, treinamento e hipercuidado; forte gerenciamento de defeitos/rastreabilidade.

• Configurar e entregar soluções SAP SD de Vendas e Faturamento; dar suporte a implementações, melhorias e suporte à produção.

• Conduzir workshops, capturar requisitos e produzir documentos de design (BPML, BBP, FS/Config, RICEF).

• Projetar e testar cenários OTC: padrão, devoluções/reclamações, vendas a terceiros e entre empresas, consignação, notas de crédito/débito e processos de desconto/liquidação.

• Integrar com FI para reconhecimento/lançamentos de receita, lançamentos de impostos e com MM/LE para logística e expedição; trabalhar com interfaces (IDoc/API/CPI/EDI).

• Preparar scripts de teste; executar Unidade/SIT; dar suporte a UAT; gerenciar defeitos e garantir a rastreabilidade aos requisitos.

• Planejar e executar o cutover: vendas/entregas em aberto, carteira de cobrança, condições de precificação, cadastro de clientes, dados de crédito;

• Ministrar treinamento para o usuário final e POPs.

• Fornecer suporte hipercuidado e estável; monitorar KPIs de OTC e impulsionar melhorias contínuas.

Quem somos:

title: Sales Account Executive (Fluent English)
description:
Sales Account Executive – U.S. Market (Remote)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top Brazilian talent with global companies that value performance, consistency, and growth. With over 10 years of experience in outsourcing and staff augmentation, we provide a structured and high-performance environment for sales professionals who aim to grow internationally. This position is for sales professionals ready to lead B2B prospecting in the U.S. market , with real opportunities for development, recognition, and long-term stability.

  • Monthly compensation of R$5,000 reais + USD-based bonuses ;
  • 100% remote work, Monday to Friday (1 p.m. – 10 p.m. BRT);

  • Intensive onboarding (3–5 weeks) and internal certifications.


What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and qualify B2B leads through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach;
  • Track key sales metrics and pipeline performance;
  • Conduct meetings and present solutions to U.S.-based executives;
  • Collaborate with Business Development and CRM teams for process improvement;
  • Maintain a disciplined, results-driven sales rhythm.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in Business Sales / Outbound reach ;
  • Fluent English (C1+) – clear, natural communication in meetings;
  • Familiar with SPIN Selling, BANT , or other sales frameworks;
  • Tech-savvy, organized, multitasker, and highly reliable;
  • Comfortable working under goals and fast-paced environments.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)


About the role:

As an Sales Account Manager , you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America’s product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a target-driven environment and enjoys developing long-term relationships with clients.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Sales Growth : As a hunter in the sales field, develop and nurture relationships with existing clients while identifying and securing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consultative Selling : Engage with key decision-makers in small to midsize organizations to present and position BSI products and services, helping them meet ISO standards.
  • Pipeline Development : Identify and qualify new business leads, building a continuous sales pipeline to support long-term success.
  • Client Relationship Management : Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.
  • Market Trend Identification : Stay ahead of industry trends, strategizing to capture new revenue generation opportunities.
  • Accurate Reporting : Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.
  • Travel for Success : Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Sales Experience : At least four years of experience in sales.
  • Industry Knowledge : Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills : Strong ability to negotiate, influence, and build relationships with both internal teams and external clients.
  • Collaboration Mindset : Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Tech-Savvy : Experience with CRM tools like SAP and Salesforce is an advantage.
  • Valid Driver's License : Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.


Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.


  • If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes.   • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.

  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.

title: Especialista em Dados e Analytics (Foco em Microsoft Fabric e Power BI)
description:
O Grupo IN / NowVertical Company, empresa multinacional canadense de capital aberto com foco no segmento de Tecnologia, está com oportunidade de ESPECIALISTA EM DADOS E ANALYTICS (MICROSOFT FABRIC | POWER BI | QLIK) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de um cliente nosso do segmento de energia.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Dados e Analytics para integrar nossa equipe de Consultores e será responsável por:


Análise de Dados: Transformar dados brutos em insights estratégicos, conduzindo análises profundas para identificação de padrões, tendências e oportunidades de negócio.

Visualização de Dados: Desenvolver dashboards gerenciais e relatórios interativos de alto impacto utilizando Power BI e Qlik Sense, garantindo clareza visual e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Sustentação e Evolução de Plataformas: Gerenciar e otimizar soluções existentes em Qlik Sense, assegurando performance, governança e acuracidade das informações, além de apoiar a transição e coexistência entre plataformas.

Modelagem, Integração e Orquestração de Dados: Projetar pipelines de dados fim a fim no ecossistema Microsoft Fabric, realizar integração de múltiplas fontes no OneLake e aplicar boas práticas de governança, consistência e qualidade dos dados.

Automação e Otimização Técnica: Utilizar SQL e Python para automatizar processos de ingestão, tratamento e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e precisão nas entregas.

Levantamento de Requisitos com o Negócio: Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções analíticas aderentes e alinhadas a melhores práticas de mercado.


O que buscamos:

• Experiência consolidada em Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Engenharia de Dados etc.)

• Experiência consolidada em Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Engenharia de Dados etc.)

• Domínio avançado em Power BI (modelagem semântica, DAX, Power Query e arquitetura Star Schema)

• Forte capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e propor soluções orientadas a valor

• Excelente comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e executivos.


Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento em governança de dados em ambientes Fabric

• Experiência em projetos de migração entre plataformas de BI

• Vivência em boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade de soluções analíticas

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

• Noções de Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP)


Competências Comportamentais:

• Habilidade para atuar com autonomia e visão consultiva

• Capacidade de organizar prioridades e entregar com consistência

• Proatividade para propor melhorias e soluções inovadoras

• Comunicação clara e objetiva, traduzindo dados em informação estratégica

• 100% Remoto

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.
