title: CRM Engineer – Integration & Automation
description:
CRM Engineer – Integration & Automation (Contractor)

Schedule: 40 hours per week – Remote


About the Role

Our cliente is looking for a CRM Engineer to join our Integration & Automation team , responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable integrations and automation solutions across business systems.

This role requires a professional with solid hands-on engineering experience — someone who can go beyond configuration and actively build, integrate, and optimize workflows across multiple platforms.



Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems (including NetSuite and marketing automation platforms).
  • Build automation solutions leveraging Workato , MuleSoft , and custom code (Node.js, JavaScript).
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance) to understand business processes and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop APIs and workflows that enhance data flow and system interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure consistent system performance and scalability.
  • Follow best practices in source control, deployment, and DevOps methodologies for CRM and automation systems.


Required Technical Skills

  • Salesforce (Sales, Service, or CPQ modules) – CPQ experience preferred but not mandatory.
  • Workato (highly preferred) or MuleSoft for system integration and automation.
  • Node.js and JavaScript – strong hands-on experience required.
  • NetSuite (from an integration perspective).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs , OAuth , and SSO .
  • Experience with “drag-and-drop” style integration builders.



Preferred Experience

  • Experience developing or supporting Salesforce automation (Apex, Triggers, LWC).
  • Familiarity with Heroku , Python , or microservice architectures .
  • Exposure to DevOps , Git branching , and Agile methodologies .
  • Experience with Salesforce frameworks like CPQ, Experience Cloud, or Einstein.
  • Solid understanding of data flows, declarative automation vs. custom development, and integration best practices.


Ideal Profile

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proactive communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Focused on delivering scalable, reliable, and maintainable integration solutions.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Senior React Engineer (LATAM | English C1/C2)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior React Engineer to join one of our U.S.-based partner teams as part of an embedded engineering unit. You will work on complex, high-impact applications—often within industries such as finance, insurance, or other data-heavy domains—collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers.


This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, excellent communication skills, and the ability to quickly understand and contribute to existing codebases and systems.


Who We’re Looking For


A developer who:


  • Builds clean, scalable, maintainable React applications
  • Understands complex systems and can onboard quickly
  • Can collaborate with cross-functional teams in English (C1/C2)
  • Is reliable, consistent, and committed — no flakiness
  • Thrives in fast-paced, structured environments
  • Can contribute technically and communicate clearly
Qualifications & Experience


Required:


  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong expertise in React.js and the React ecosystem
  • Experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript
  • Experience integrating with REST APIs or GraphQL
  • Ability to work with existing systems and architectures
  • Solid understanding of component patterns, state management, and performance
  • Experience with Git workflows, CI/CD, and code reviews
  • English C1/C2 — strong communication and collaboration
  • Ability to work independently and within an embedded team


Nice to Have (Bonus):


  • Experience in fintech or financial systems (highly valued but not required)
  • Experience with Node.js or backend services
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience writing automated tests (Jest, Cypress, etc.)
  • Understanding of accessibility and security best practices
  • Experience with enterprise-scale systems


Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain high-quality React applications
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PM, Design, Backend)
  • Understand existing systems and contribute to new features and improvements
  • Participate in technical discussions, planning, and code reviews
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production and integration issues
  • Adapt quickly to project needs and changing requirements
  • Follow best practices, patterns, and engineering standards
  • Communicate progress and blockers clearly


What We Offer


  • Competitive USD rate
  • Opportunity to work on impactful U.S. projects in evolving industries
  • Fully remote role aligned with U.S. EST time zone
  • PTO

title: Consultor de GRC Júnior (Governance, Risk and Compliance)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos a Cipher, uma empresa do grupo Prosegur especializada em Cibersegurança. A Prosegur é líder global no setor em serviços integrados de segurança (vigilância e tecnologia corporativa), monitoramento de alarmes, transporte de valores. Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Valorizamos e incentivamos o conhecimento técnico e a capacidade de inovar de Nossa Gente e acreditamos que assim é possível atingir nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais seguro para todos.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.


Quais são os desafios?

  • Realizar avaliações de Segurança da Informação em ambientes de baixa complexidade, baseadas nas melhores práticas de mercado (PCI-DSS, ISO27001, NIST, etc), apresentando parecer e sugestões de cenários para mitigar os riscos identificados e pontos de melhoria;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios ao cliente que contemplem o resultado da avaliação realizada;
  • Executar projetos relacionados a consultoria e avaliações em PCI DSS;
  • Participar de projetos de Classificação da Informação, ISO 27001, Gestão de Acessos, Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Análise de Riscos;
  • Elaborar documentos técnicos, pesquisas e análises tecnológicas voltadas à segurança da informação para atender aos requisitos regulatórios, através de pesquisa em virtude de alguma tecnologia específica para atender algum projeto em vigência ou apoio a clientes, com o objetivo de apoiar os clientes na tomada de decisão servindo como uma referência externa e consultiva;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas de acordo com orientação e determinação superior.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em Segurança da Informação; Protocolos TCP/IP; Arquitetura de Redes; Sistemas Operacionais; ISO 27001; PCI DSS; NIST; CIS, Análise de Riscos; Plano de Continuidade de Negócios.
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura de sistemas, protocolos de redes e as melhores práticas de segurança para estas implementações;
  • Entendimento de ferramentas, tecnologias, estratégias de segurança e suas implicações no ambiente de negócios;
  • Inglês intermediário e desejável Espanhol básico.
  • Superior completo ou cursando, em áreas de Ciência da Computação, Segurança da Informação ou similar;


O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: FULL STACK C#/.net + ReactJs (PLENO)
description:
FULL STACK C#/.net + ReactJs (PLENO )


¡El español avanzado para conversar con usuarios de Latinoamérica es un requisito indispensable!


Cliente: Universal Music LATAM


Responsabilidades y Funciones

• Contribuir al desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones .NET escalables, con énfasis en la calidad y el rendimiento.

• Participar en la evolución continua de la arquitectura de software, proponiendo mejoras y soluciones.

• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios de producto, diseño y control de calidad para ofrecer soluciones alineadas con las necesidades del negocio.

• Diagnosticar y corregir errores en un entorno de producción.

• Apoyar la fiabilidad de los pipelines de CI/CD.

• Participar activamente en ceremonias ágiles y contribuir a la mejora de los procesos internos.


Habilidades Técnicas

• Más de 3 años de experiencia práctica con React y el ecosistema .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework).

• Sólidos conocimientos de arquitectura de software y mejores prácticas de desarrollo.

• Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL, SQL) y fundamentos de bases de datos no relacionales.

• Experiencia con pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions o similar). • Experiencia con pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions o similar).

• Experiencia en el desarrollo de APIs RESTful e integraciones de sistemas.

• Conocimiento de pruebas automatizadas (unitarias y de integración).

• Experiencia en entornos ágiles (Scrum o Kanban).

• Conocimiento de tecnologías web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript y TypeScript).


Perfil de comportamiento

• Comunicación clara y objetiva, con capacidad para compartir conocimientos, alinear expectativas técnicas y colaborar con diferentes áreas del equipo.

• Proactividad y actitud colaborativa, anticipándose a los problemas y contribuyendo activamente a su resolución.

• Pensamiento analítico aplicado a la resolución de retos técnicos, siempre guiado por datos y buenas prácticas.

• Apertura a la retroalimentación y al aprendizaje continuo, con el objetivo de evolucionar en lenguaje, herramientas, estándares y enfoques según las necesidades del proyecto.


Ventajas:

• Certificaciones relacionadas con el ecosistema .NET o AWS.

• Experiencia previa con productos de big data.

• Inglés intermedio o avanzado para la comunicación técnica.


Expectativas salariales a convenir.


Horario: Lunes a viernes (10:00 a 19:00)

Tipo de empleo: Miembro/Asociado de la cooperativa (similar a una persona jurídica)

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).
  • Participate in design discussions for future migration to Snowflake and/or a data lake architecture.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.

title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.



Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.



Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.



Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: AWS Developer (Data Lake)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior AWS Developer to support the design and implementation of a large-scale data lake and analytics platform within a leading financial institution. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise across the AWS ecosystem and the ability to deliver complex solutions independently while collaborating effectively within a high-performing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and workflows within the AWS ecosystem.

· Build and optimize components for the data lake using Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, and Iceberg.

· Write efficient and maintainable Python or Spark scripts for data ingestion, transformation, and automation.

· Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform to deploy and manage AWS services.

· Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure high-quality, performant, and reliable data delivery.

· Contribute to code reviews, testing improvements, and performance optimization.

· Participate in solution design discussions, bringing forward ideas and accepting feedback in a collaborative, team-first manner.

Required Qualifications

· Strong AWS expertise, especially in data and analytics services (Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Iceberg).

· Proficient in Python or Spark scripting for automation and data engineering tasks.

· Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, analytics platforms, and SQL.

· Experience working in financial services and familiarity with banking data terminology,

· Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team of senior developers.

· Strong focus on performance, code quality, and continuous improvement.

· Takes initiative to identify opportunities for improvement in testing, performance, and architecture.

· Communicates constructively and is open to giving and receiving feedback.

· Balances ownership and teamwork, understanding that success is a collective effort.

· Fluent English.


Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:


1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth


Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Frontend .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Rich UI development in Blazor - building interactive and responsive user interfaces
  • ASP.NET Core 9 - for frontend integration and modern web development
  • Proven experience with frontend web development and consuming REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Blazor Hybrid (WinForms Blazor) for desktop application UIs
  • Working knowledge of MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) for clean UI architecture and maintainability
  • Experience implementing frontend authentication using OAuth, JWT, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus


This is an exciting new project where they are developing an innovative system to automate the client's process using robotics.



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

· Work with the offshore technical team to build the solution and clarify their queries.

· Training core users of the customer.

· Manage customer user acceptance tests.

· Work with the project managers to align with project milestones and ensure timely billing.

Required Skills/Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a Computer Sciences or a related field.

· Experience with Kronos and UKG Workforce Management is MANDATORY.

· English Advanced (B2-C1)

· Experience in requirement gathering and solution design.

· Prior experience in supporting functional testing, integration testing, and UAT preferred.

· Demonstrated track record in delivering quality, on-time technology and business solutions to a diverse customer base.

· Solid interpersonal skills to interface with co-workers and customers.

· Ability to manage specific tasks to completion with minimal direction.

· Ability to collaborate with clients, identify engagement follow-on opportunities, and a strong desire to excel.

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

title: AWS Developer (Data Lake)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior AWS Developer to support the design and implementation of a large-scale data lake and analytics platform within a leading financial institution. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise across the AWS ecosystem and the ability to deliver complex solutions independently while collaborating effectively within a high-performing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and workflows within the AWS ecosystem.

· Build and optimize components for the data lake using Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, and Iceberg.

· Write efficient and maintainable Python or Spark scripts for data ingestion, transformation, and automation.

· Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform to deploy and manage AWS services.

· Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure high-quality, performant, and reliable data delivery.

· Contribute to code reviews, testing improvements, and performance optimization.

· Participate in solution design discussions, bringing forward ideas and accepting feedback in a collaborative, team-first manner.

Required Qualifications

· Strong AWS expertise, especially in data and analytics services (Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Iceberg).

· Proficient in Python or Spark scripting for automation and data engineering tasks.

· Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, analytics platforms, and SQL.

· Experience working in financial services and familiarity with banking data terminology,

· Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team of senior developers.

· Strong focus on performance, code quality, and continuous improvement.

· Takes initiative to identify opportunities for improvement in testing, performance, and architecture.

· Communicates constructively and is open to giving and receiving feedback.

· Balances ownership and teamwork, understanding that success is a collective effort.

· Fluent English.


Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hartmann Young is partnered with a fast-growing global leader in health, nutrition, and wellness ingredients, known for its science-led innovation and rapid international expansion. As the business continues to scale, we are seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager South America to drive immediate commercial impact and elevate the company’s presence across the nutraceutical market.


We’re looking for someone who brings genuine industry influence, including:

  • A strong book of business and established relationships with brand owners, CMOs/CDMOs, and major consumer health companies
  • Proven success selling key nutraceutical dosage forms — tablets, capsules, softgels, and gummys.


If you’re commercially driven, well-connected, and excited by the opportunity to shape partnerships in a high-growth environment, this role offers an exceptional platform to make a meaningful and immediate impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business growth by leveraging your existing network and opening high-value commercial opportunities
  • Develop and expand strategic partnerships with global key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and contract manufacturers
  • Lead the full business development cycle — from opportunity identification to negotiation and long-term strategic planning
  • Translate scientific and technical capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver integrated go-to-market strategies
  • Manage contracts, commercial terms, and performance optimisation across partnership lifecycles
  • Support international expansion through new market development and strategic alliances
  • Represent the business at leading industry trade shows and events to strengthen brand visibility and network reach.


Key Requirements

  • You can be located anywhere within South America to qualify for this market.
  • 8+ years’ experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within nutraceuticals, ingredients, food, or life sciences within South America.
  • A well-established book of business and strong relationships across the nutraceutical ecosystem
  • Direct experience selling tablets, capsules, softgels, gummys, or related dosage forms
  • Proven ability to generate revenue growth and close complex commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to convert technical innovation into business value
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, hands-on environment
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups
  • Experience with Stimulus, Turbo, Tailwind, Sidekiq, or Heroku Shield


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.


You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.


At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.

  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • É parte do seu trabalho não apenas reduzir o custo de expansão da audiência, mas conseguir qualificar leads das mais diferentes classes sociais, tornando a comunicação mais ativa, consistente e valiosa.
  • É seu dever manter uma comunicação clara, direta e respeitosa, contribuindo com insights estratégicos para capacitar não apenas o seu departamento, mas também o time de produto.


Requisitos:

Buscamos alguém que já compreenda todas as implicações decorrentes do nome e do tom característico da marca. Alguém que não precisa de explicações óbvias para captar a essência do Pobre e transformá-la em conteúdo de alto impacto.

  • Se você não se considera cronicamente online, não faz ideia do que é um shitpost, jamais foi heavy user de Twitter/X e é desconectado desses mundos, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.
  • Organização, autogestão e compromisso com prazos e entregas são inegociáveis. Esperamos maturidade e responsabilidade profissional.
  • Aqui é um lugar de paz. Desenvolver e liderar as equipes, deve ser um processo natural, sempre se comunicando de maneira eficiente, humana e respeitosa.
  • Você precisa entender técnicas avançadas de copywriting, gatilhos mentais e storytelling.

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming.

Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.


SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: Executivo de Vendas (Brasil)
description:
Sobre a greenmetrics.ai


A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para ajudar cidades na adaptação climática e sustentabilidade ambiental.


Desenvolvemos sistemas de sensores inteligentes e análises de dados avançadas para coletar e processar informações ambientais, contribuindo diretamente para aumentar a resiliência das cidades frente a enchentes e alagamentos.


Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.


Somos uma startup independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 15 cidades em Portugal e no Brasil, em rápida expansão.


Sobre a vaga


Esta é uma oportunidade para quem quer vender com propósito e ter impacto positivo no mundo real. 


Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos. 


No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes. 


Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos.


Suas responsabilidades


  • Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades na Região Sul do Brasil (RS/SC/PR).
  • Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitorização hidrológica e detecção antecipada de inundações.
  • Gerir o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada.
  • Preparar provas de conceito com leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais.
  • Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas.
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição para implementação e sucesso do cliente.
  • Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.
  • Coletar feedback do cliente para o time de produto/engenharia.


O que procuramos


  • +5 anos em vendas B2B ou para o setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS.
  • Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast.
  • Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência.
  • Base na região de Porto Alegre ou Florianópolis e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório).
  • Formação em engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia é desejável.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas.
  • Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor.
  • Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial.
  • Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.


Como se candidatar


Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência.


Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos.


Prazo de candidatura: 25/nov

title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: SAP Integration Lead (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Integration Lead

We are looking for a consultant able to lead integration processes accross all levels of our client's environment, in contact with stakeholders and also with outside partners.

Together with the leading skills and understanding of the business, the ideal profile would have a strong technical background in SAP SD; SAP ABAP; SAP Order-to-Cash and EDI & Idoc Integration.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide solution architect leadership & strategy development.
  • Lead Technical architect for medium to large projects.
  • Accountable across multiple functional and technical areas with wide range of complexity.
  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.
  • Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture to make sure that the solution fits within enterprise context, while also ensures solutions align with business goals and processes, and follow client's IT Standards and Best Practices.
  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.
  • Coordinates complex solution architecture implementations while leading design variances based upon business needs. Ensures artifacts are documented.
  • Coordinates engagements with internal and external parties as they relate to evaluation, design and delivery of business capabilities.
  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.
  • Participant in industry representation, policy formation, User Groups, and strategic direction.
  • Provides coaching and leadership to system software developers through enhancements and projects.
  • Works well with varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).
  • Able to understand business requirements to turn into technical specification solutions.
  • Stay abreast of latest technologies in his/her functional space, consistently growing in knowledge and industry trends.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years IT professional work experience.
  • Mandatory to have excellent fluency in English; both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Candidate will be regarded as SME and should have high level of expertise in SAP - SD component.
  • Strong ABAP skills, with complex troubleshooting experience.
  • SAP Order-to-Cash end to end expertise required (SD).
  • EDI and Idoc experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in software engineering, software development, solution architecture and able to develop a High Level Design (HLD) and ideally with ability to deliver Low Level Designs within area of expertise.
  • Experience in highly integrated complex data environments e.g. EDI/ BI/ ETL, ERP etc, and open to working in a multitude of SAP and NonSAP applications and technologies.
  • Candidate should possess high level of consultative skills and have prior experience of collaborating with Business Analysts and Enterprise Architects in solving complex business problems with innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking
  • Self-motivated and self-starting on work
  • Strong Technical leadership of Application Development teams and vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and methodologies
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can quickly cultivate networking opportunities within the organization at varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Broad range of business and IT experiences
  • Hold technical and/or business certification(s).
  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:

We are looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Application Developer to design, build, and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in modern architectures, enjoys working with Java/Spring Boot, and has hands-on experience with AKS and CI/CD environments.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, por meio de conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Apoio a criação do plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos, de forma suficiente à posterior compreensão da atividade executada;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.
  • Desenvolver os trabalhos de depuração e testes de programa, executando serviços de manutenção nos programas já existentes identificando as causas de erros e realizar as correções necessárias a fim de obter os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Receber a especificação funcional para desenvolvimento, melhoria e manutenção de softwares, avaliar e estimar o tempo necessário para execução de acordo com o previsto na proposta técnica;
  • Realizar testes básicos da codificação efetuada, de acordo com as instruções contidas na especificação, de forma a minimizar a propagação de erros para a fase de testes;
  • Entender e discutir a estratégia de codificação com o Especialista e/ou Analista da equipe e codificar a solução de software necessária para atender o recurso definido para o produto seguindo as diretrizes, políticas e estratégias da empresa;
  • Apoiar na realização de testes automatizados, unidade, integração, desempenho etc.
  • Aplicar procedimentos definidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento, com base nas especificações detalhadas das funcionalidades a serem criadas no projeto;
  • Transformar requisitos em um sistema pronto, bem como realizar as fases de elaboração de requisitos e da programação de sistemas; Conhecer tecnicamente as fases das atividades, identificar e orientar a solução de problemas;
  • Utilizar a ferramenta e os procedimentos estabelecidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento da empresa para reportar problemas encontrados, indicar o progresso das suas atividades, apontar horas trabalhadas e demais informações aplicáveis;
  • Contribuir na estimativa de novas funcionalidades e na avaliação do impacto de novos requisitos a projetos, com relação à complexidade e viabilidade do esforço da implementação desenvolvida.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de negócio com o objetivo de desenhar e desenvolver;
  • Entender, criar, manipular e consultar bancos de dados visando a execução das etapas de desenvolvimento do programa;
  • Corrigir e propor melhorias em bugs, bem como desenvolver novas funcionalidades para os sistemas propondo soluções/melhorias e realizar a implantação das funcionalidades em ambientes;
  • Definir soluções técnicas de acordo com a tecnologia utilizada nos projetos em desenvolvimento, através da produção de código limpo e eficiente;
  • Participar do sprint para elaboração do plano de trabalho e distribuição das atividades, bem como programar, implementar e manter rotinas;
  • Alinhar com o gestor a demanda, funcionalidades e aplicação nas operações de desenvolvimento;
  • Projetar e desenvolver APIs de integração capazes de lidar com alto volume de dados;
  • Buscar novas ferramentas e técnicas para a melhoria contínua de nossos sistemas;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação e compliance estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação :

  • Graduando ou Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software e desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e/ou microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react, Java, Sprint boot, SQL;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando as linguagens.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Programação orientada a objetos;
  • Análise de Sistemas;
  • Conhecimento sobre o CAR (Cadastro Ambiental Rural).


Informações adicionais:

Por que escolher a VEGA?

Modelo de Trabalho Moderno:

  • Trabalho 100% Remoto ou Híbrido, se você estiver próximo à nossa sede (São José dos Campos) ou hubs (Lavras e Piracicaba).

title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: Analista de Sistemas Sr - Implantação de Sistemas
description:
A Copel é uma das maiores empresas de energia do Brasil, atuando em geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização. Nosso propósito é levar energia e soluções que impulsionam o desenvolvimento sustentável.


Acreditamos que diversidade, inclusão e responsabilidade social fazem parte de uma empresa forte e conectada com o futuro. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas, de diferentes origens, gêneros, raças, idades e orientações, são bem-vindas.


Aqui, o que faz a diferença são as pessoas. Buscamos talentos que queiram crescer junto com a gente, com ética, respeito, inovação e vontade de transformar.


Quer fazer parte de um projeto inovador que transforma o setor de distribuição de energia com tecnologia de ponta? Estamos em busca de um Analista de Sistemas para atuar na implantação de sistemas comerciais e de engenharia , com foco na modernização de processos e soluções .


O que você vai fazer:

  • Apoiar a implantação de sistemas na área comercial e de engenharia com foco em distribuição de energia, liderando o mapeamento e migração de dados de sistemas legados para plataformas modernas;
  • Participar ativamente das discussões técnicas e propor soluções inovadoras para sistemas de grande porte;
  • Suportar a migração de dados junto com equipes de negócios e fornecedores, assegurando a integridade e qualidade da transição;
  • Definir estratégias eficientes de ETL para garantir agilidade e qualidade nos processos;
  • Gerenciar contratos e interagir com parceiros de tecnologia envolvidos no desenvolvimento das soluções.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação (Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Ciências da Computação ou áreas correlatas);
  • Domínio avançado de SQL, PL/SQL e modelagem de banco de dados;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento em Python e Big Query para análise de dados;
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação técnica (fala, leitura e escrita);
  • Vivência na implantação de sistemas Oracle em cloud, com conhecimentos em OCI, OIC e OIA;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados, especialmente Oracle Golden Gate;
  • Sólida experiência em levantamento de requisitos e mapeamento de processos de negócio;
  • Habilidade para levantamento de requisitos e mapeamento de negócios.


Por que trabalhar conosco?
