title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).

  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: Senior Account Executive (Hunter) — Dados, Governança & IA
description:
Sobre a Apgar

Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Management, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com presença global e reconhecimento do mercado. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — de estratégia e governança até a implementação e operação de soluções de Analytics, MDM, Data Platform e AI — ajudando organizações a transformar dados em valor de negócio sustentável.


Além de serviços, temos ofertas proprietárias e aceleradores (como o ApgarIA para manufatura e supply chain (produção, previsão de demanda, agentes de IA, etc.) — e um portfólio robusto de casos e parcerias tecnológicas que ampliam o impacto nos clientes.


O que Oferecemos:


  • Ambiente global com equipes em 4 continentes
  • Empresa reconhecida internacionalmente, com metodologias próprias, ofertas de AI e stack tecnológica ampla para construir soluções de alto impacto.
  • Somos certificados Great Place to Work no Brasil ,
  • Oferecemos trilhas de formação contínua e coaching de carreira ; cultura colaborativa e meritocrática.
  • Pacote competitivo (salário + variável) e benefícios, com flexibilidade e possibilidade de atuação remota/híbrida.


Local de Trabalho: São Paulo ou Porto Alegre (modelo híbrido/remoto)


Responsabilidades:

Buscamos um(a) hunter nato(a) , apaixonado(a) por Account-Based Selling/Marketing (ABS/ABM) , para abrir novos logos enterprise (médias e grandes contas) que investem em Dados, Governança e IA . Você vai liderar o ciclo comercial completo, da prospecção executiva ao fechamento, orquestrando a proposta de valor da Apgar e conectando-a às dores reais dos clientes.


O que você vai vender


  • Consultoria para programas de Governança de Dados e Estratégia de Dados .
  • Apgar Pathfinder (nossa metodologia para aceleração e priorização de Dados e IA, quick wins/MVP e roadmap integrado entre valor de negócio, fundações de dados e plataforma).
  • Licenças de parceiros líderes de mercado (ex.: Soluções de MDM, Data Catalog, BI, Plataformas de Dados)
  • Serviços de Implementação de soluções MDM , Data Catalog e Plataformas de Dados (ex.: Databricks, Snowflake), além de Analytics & AI .
  • Produtos e Aceleradores Apgar
  • Serviços de Sustentação das soluções implementadas


Principais responsabilidades

  • Hunting com ABS/ABM: mapear contas-alvo, identificar buying centers (C-level, Data Leaders, TI, Operações) e conduzir abordagens multithread.
  • Prospecção executiva: construir relacionamento consultivo, qualificar dores (valor, risco, eficiência), definir hipóteses de valor e próximos passos.
  • Arquitetar a proposta de valor: liderar a coordenação de propostas (escopo, storytelling, casos de uso/ROI, investimento), orquestrando times técnicos para estimativas e demonstrações .
  • Pilotar o funil e forecast: gerir pipeline no CRM, definir e acompanhar plays com o(a) SDR (lista-alvo, mensagens, MQL→SQL), e garantir cadência de reuniões qualificadas.
  • Parcerias: trabalhar com parceiros tecnológicos na conquista de novos negócios.
  • Representar a Apgar em eventos do ecossistema de dados/IA .


Perfil que buscamos

  • Hunter com histórico consistente de abertura de novos logos enterprise em serviços consultoria de dados/IA, governança, MDM ou plataformas de dados.
  • Linguagem de negócio + fluência técnica : fala com CDO/CIO/COO e também debate em bom nível com equipes de dados e governança (sem precisar ser “mão no código”).
  • ABS/ABM practitioner : sabe montar account plans , mapear poder/influência, criar value hypotheses e navegar ciclos complexos.
  • Experiente na Orquestração de propostas ponta a ponta, com ownership da narrativa de valor e da negociação .
  • Networking ativo no ecossistema corporativo de Dados, TI e AI no Brasil/LatAm capaz de gerar pipeline.
  • Comunicação impecável (português) e inglês/espanhol valorizados para LatAm.


Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Casos vendidos/entregues envolvendo MDM (Customer/Product 360) , Catálogo de Dados, Programas Governança , Databricks/Snowflake , AI/ML .
  • Vivência em metodologias de valor e roadmap (ex.: priorização esforço×impacto, MVP, “from business value to foundations & platform”).
  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).


Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).
  • Pipeline saudável (cobertura, taxa de conversão, ciclo médio).
  • MVPs/PoVs vendidos com tese de valor clara (Pathfinder → MVP → roll-out).
  • Ativação de parceiros e geração de oportunidades conjuntas.



Apgar Group é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades e valoriza a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou deficiência.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as an influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to contribute to various initiatives as well as provide feedback through code reviews and pairing. We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.


- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB - Have input into design and architectural decisions that will shape the future of our software systems - Mentor, actively participate in code reviews, and pair up with a team member to work together on features - Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


✅ Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements:

- 7+ years of web application development experience with a track record of successfully shipping consumer or business facing products - Experience in writing reliable and maintainable code, reusable components and component libraries that may be used by many other engineers

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods


Preferred Requirements: - Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React - Experience with GraphQL - Experience building microservices - Experience building eCommerce platforms - Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic - Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. Title: ITSM FreshService Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Contract: 12+ Months


We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive ITSM Engineer with proven experience in Freshservice to lead and optimize our IT service management platform. This role is critical in driving operational excellence, enhancing user experience, and aligning service delivery with business needs.

This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil. At Cepheid, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Freshservice Platform Ownership

  • Configure, customize, and maintain Freshservice modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Service Catalog.

Process Optimization & Governance

  • Design and refine ITSM processes aligned with ITIL best practices.

Stakeholder Engagement

Innovation & Integration

  • Explore and implement new Freshservice features and third-party integrations to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Support initiatives around self-service, knowledge management, and AI-driven support.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3–5 years of experience in ITSM roles, with at least 2 years hands-on experience in Freshservice administration and configuration.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL framework and service management principles.
  • Experience with automation, scripting, and API integrations within Freshservice.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

5%-15% travel as per business requirements

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as an influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to contribute to various initiatives as well as provide feedback through code reviews and pairing. We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.


- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB - Have input into design and architectural decisions that will shape the future of our software systems - Mentor, actively participate in code reviews, and pair up with a team member to work together on features - Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


✅ Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements:

- 7+ years of web application development experience with a track record of successfully shipping consumer or business facing products - Experience in writing reliable and maintainable code, reusable components and component libraries that may be used by many other engineers

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods


Preferred Requirements: - Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React - Experience with GraphQL - Experience building microservices - Experience building eCommerce platforms - Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic - Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and an alumni of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA.


We power deliveries for local food and beverage businesses in Boston, New York, DC, Chicago, LA, and other major metropolitan areas. Our technology is at the center of our delivery marketplace.


Intro video:


Why should you join Metrobi?

  • Play a key role in shaping performance marketing strategy.
  • Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with plenty of room to test & learn.
  • Opportunity to directly impact conversions and revenue.
  • International team experience and a supportive work environment.
  • A well-funded company that offers competitive compensation.
  • An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment.
  • A chance to become a part of a dynamic company on a fast track to change the logistics scene in the US.


About the role

We’re looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who loves experimenting, optimizing, and scaling growth. If you enjoy working with WordPress and creating compelling content for emails and landing pages, this role is for you.


  • Professional English Proficiency is a must.
  • Hiring interviews will be conducted online.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and iterate on landing pages (WordPress + Elementor), testing buttons, hero texts, CTAs, and layouts.
  • Run A/B tests & experiments to improve conversion rates continuously.
  • Track, analyze, and report performance.
  • Understand the audience and work on improving the copy from email marketing campaigns.


What we’re looking for:

  • Strong knowledge of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • An analytical marketing mindset, while being quick to iterate on ideas.
  • Creative problem solver who thrives on experimentation and iteration.
  • Hands-on experience with WordPress & Elementor.
  • Experience with creating content for emails and or landing pages


Nice to have:

  • SEO basics
  • Basic HTML/CSS
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles for better user journeys.
  • Experience with Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets


  • This is a remote position.
  • Must be able to work between (9AM-6PM EST)

title: Contracting Manager (Activities & Experiences)
description:
Contracting Manager (supplier negotiations)

Location – Brazil

Full Time


About Us

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of HBX Group to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of activities within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for HBX Group.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of HBX Group value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or activities industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of HBX Group to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of activities within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for HBX Group.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of HBX Group value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or activities industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Banco de Talentos - Afirmativo para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD/PwD)
description:
Banco de Talentos - Afirmativo para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD/PwD)


A Cyncly é construída a partir de marcas, que juntas, somam mais de 35 anos de experiência, fornecendo soluções especializadas de projetos, vendas, fabricação e conteúdo para clientes que desejam dar vida aos espaços. Nosso negócio abrange as indústrias de cozinha, banheiros, móveis, pisos, janelas, portas e vidros. As operações da Cyncly estão presentes na América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul, Ásia-Pacífico e África, tornando-se uma potência mundial e líder neste segmento.


O banco de talentos é aberto a todas as pessoas com deficiência que buscam novas oportunidades de carreira. Valorizamos a diversidade de experiências, habilidades e formações acadêmicas. Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e está em busca de novos desafios, queremos conhecê-lo!

Venha fazer parte da Cyncly!

  • Experiência em times ágeis e ambientes de alta complexidade;
  • Vivência com integração de sistemas, automação e CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade, performance e seguranç;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar o desenvolvimento técnico de novas funcionalidades e arquiteturas de frontend com React;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código, performance e componentização;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores por meio de code reviews, pair programming e feedbacks construtivos;
  • Contribuir para a definição e evolução de padrões de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy;
  • Atuar na integração de APIs complexas e no processamento de fluxos de dados em grande escala;
  • Colaborar com Arquitetos, Tech Leads e Product Owners para criar soluções escaláveis e robustas;
  • Garantir a implementação de testes abrangentes e a automação de pipelines de CI/CD no frontend;
  • Otimizar performance e solucionar problemas complexos nos sistemas;
  • Assegurar alta cobertura de testes automatizados e fomentar uma cultura contínua de qualidade;
  • Desenvolver componentes complexos e reutilizáveis utilizando React, TypeScript e Material UI;
  • Arquitetar e otimizar o gerenciamento de estado com Redux/Redux Toolkit, incluindo criação de middlewares customizados;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com ESLint, Prettier e TypeScript;
  • Implementar e otimizar comunicação em tempo real com WebSockets;
  • Containerizar aplicações com Docker para ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Us

At MetaCTO, we specialize in helping startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products through expert app development and fractional CTO services. As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) , you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the backend infrastructure that powers innovative applications for our clients. This role will involve managing cloud environments, optimizing databases, automating deployments, and improving system observability.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at MetaCTO , you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with software engineers to improve system performance, automate operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of critical backend services. You’ll work extensively with cloud platforms like AWS, leveraging technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.

Responsibilities
  • Architect, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS, SQS, CloudWatch).
  • Manage and optimize databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL ) for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance, with specific experience using Zabbix and Elastic Logging .
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and scaling of applications.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Develop and enforce security best practices for cloud environments and infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and scripting languages like Python or Bash.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and optimize system performance.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable system design, with a strong focus on Django-based applications .
Qualifications
  • 5-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in AWS cloud services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, EKS, SQS, IAM ).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS) .
  • Deep knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) , including performance tuning, query optimization, monitoring, and migration management.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi .
  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI/CD ).
  • Proficiency in monitoring tools , specifically Zabbix , and logging solutions like Elastic Logging .
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or Go for automating operational tasks.
  • Experience working with Django-based applications in a cloud environment.
  • Experience implementing security best practices for cloud-based applications.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture .
Preferred Skills
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Experience with serverless computing and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with message queue services (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Understanding of zero-downtime deployments and disaster recovery strategies.
Position Details
  • Type: Full-Time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Hours: US Pacific Time hours
How to Apply

If you are passionate about scalability, automation, and reliability , and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and an optional brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

MetaCTO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer
description:
Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer - Remote - Brazil


ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development


We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing programming solutions to support the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. You will contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of data processing through your programming expertise.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain programming solutions for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials.
  • Collaborate with data managers, project managers, clinical data scientists, and biostatisticians to ensure the integration of programming solutions into the overall data management process.
  • Act as a primary point of contact during the study set up and maintenance phase for system programming related questions by the project team.
  • Support colleagues with the clinical trials environment and concepts of Clinical Data Management Systems.
  • Perform extracts of data from CDMS and creation of data transfer programs.
  • Act as mentor and provides guidance and support to more junior programmer levels assigned to a project.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of improvements to technical systems and processes within an SME role.
  • Provide guidance on programming best practices, coding standards, and data quality control measures.
  • Stay updated on advancements in programming languages and data management tools to enhance operational efficiencies.


Your Profile:

  • Complete bachelor’s degree relevant field such as computer science, SAS, statistics, or life sciences.
  • Extensive experience in programming for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials with proficiency in languages such as SAS, R, or Python.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and influence outcomes.
  • MUST HAVE advanced English Communication, Writing and Reading

title: Enterprise Network Engineer
description:
Enterprise Network Engineer

We’re looking for someone who knows their way around large-scale networks, understands complex routing and switching setups, and can walk into a customer conversation with confidence.

What you’ll handle

You will install, configure, test, troubleshoot, and sometimes design network solutions using Cisco routing and switching platforms. The job involves direct customer interaction, so you need to be comfortable explaining your thinking to both engineers and leadership teams.

Must-have skills

  • Strong understanding of routing and switching technologies: IGP, OSPF, EGP, BGP, STP, RSTP, VTP, VSS, vPC, vDC, MSTP, LACP, VLAN
  • Solid experience with LAN switch technologies including STP, RSTP, VTP, VSS, MSTP, LACP, VLAN, VXLAN-EVPN
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco platforms: ISR 800/1900/2900/3900/4000 series, ASR 1000, Catalyst 6500, 6800, 4500, 3850
  • Background in installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution design across routers and switches
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain network strategy to customers and internal teams
  • Comfortable in client-facing situations and capable of driving conversations across cross-functional groups

Nice to have

  • Experience leading customer workshops, creating HLD and LLD documents
  • Service Provider domain exposure: XR, ASR9K, MPLS, BGP, BNG, Segment Routing
  • Familiarity with SDA, SD-WAN, or ACI
  • Experience with Nexus switches, UCS, or Hyperflex
  • Network automation skills using Python, Ansible, Go, or Splunk

Education and Certifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • CCNA required
  • CCNP is an advantage
  • CCIE Enterprise is preferred

title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

Location: Brazil

Mode: Remote

Duration: 1 year of contract with possibility of extension


We are looking for talents in the AdOps Data Sharing team within its Performance Marketing group. This role will be the cornerstone of AdOps Data Sharing team focusing on how to use 1st and 3rd party platforms to build impactful datasets that meet the business goals.


This role will put to use your technical skills working with data technologies with a strong ability to understand the business impact of the data. AdOps is part of the Marketing Technology Operations Team and is focused on the enablement andmaintenance of Uber’s performance marketing data. The team is highly operational, technical, and analytical, responsible for setting up accurate tracking, spend ingestion and data sharing ETLs across all paid marketing ad network channels and campaigns.


Responsibilities

• Support AdOps as a specialist in the paid marketing tech space.

• Analyze marketing event data to propose platform improvements and enhance data management.

• Build data-sharing pipelines and integrations using tools such as SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Hive.

• Identify and optimize data sources while auditing data quality to improve campaign performance.

• Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to address dataset gaps and propose solutions.

• Validate technical implementations and ensure cross-functional alignment.

• Communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to guide requirements and data-sharing solutions.

• Work with vendor partners to ensure alignment with Uber’s goals.

• Troubleshoot issues by leveraging strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Take ownership of projects and demonstrate results in both collaborative and independent work.


Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in performance marketing tech, data analytics, technical solutions, or related roles.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, or a similar technical discipline.

• Strong quantitative skills and proficiency with SQL, Excel, Python, Hive, Spark, etc.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems such as JIRA or Asana.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in support or service desk roles.

• Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to non-technical partners.

• Basic understanding of app and web tracking data for performance marketing.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados – Governança e MDM
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior | Foco em Governança e MDM | 100% Remoto


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar em um projeto estratégico de evolução da arquitetura corporativa de dados em uma empresa de grande porte. A posição envolve participação ativa na definição de padrões, governança e implementação de soluções modernas para gestão e qualidade de dados.


Dedicação: full time

Local de trabalho : 100% remoto


O profissional fará parte de um time responsável por estruturar e consolidar a arquitetura de dados da organização, contribuindo diretamente para a criação de frameworks, processos e boas práticas que apoiam iniciativas corporativas de MDM, Data Catalog, Linhagem, Qualidade de Dados e Governança.


Responsabilidades principais

  • Atuar na implementação e evolução da arquitetura de dados corporativa utilizando AWS, Databricks e Glue.
  • Contribuir para o desenho de frameworks e padrões técnicos de MDM, Data Catalog e Linhagem de Dados.
  • Apoiar a criação de guides operacionais, playbooks técnicos e procedimentos de sustentação.
  • Participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas a Data Governance e organização de papéis (Data Owner, Steward, Coordinator).
  • Conduzir análises técnicas e participar de revisões junto a times de TI e áreas de negócio.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) ou Arquiteto(a) de Dados.
  • Domínio de AWS (Glue, IAM, serviços de dados), Databricks e pipelines distribuídos.
  • Sólida experiência com MDM, modelagem de dados, catálogo técnico e processos de qualidade de dados.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de governança de dados e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência na elaboração de documentações técnicas, guias e padrões (RACI, dicionários de dados, etc.).


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Certificações em Data Governance, AWS ou Databricks.
  • Experiência em projetos de Common Data Hub, Data Council ou estruturas federadas de governança.
  • Conhecimento em segurança e compliance de dados (LGPD, ISO 27001).
  • Vivência anterior em empresas dos setores de energia, infraestrutura ou tecnologia.


Se você busca um próximo passo desafiador, candidate-se e venha construir o futuro junto com a gente!

title: Power BI Analyst/Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você fará parte do time que atende uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , contribuindo em iniciativas estratégicas com foco em métricas, governança de dados e apoio à tomada de decisão.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para suporte a indicadores de negócio.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados utilizando DAX e Power Query (M).
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes como Excel, Smartsheet, SQL Server, SharePoint e Azure.
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados utilizados nas soluções de BI.
  • Levantar requisitos com stakeholders e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Documentar regras de negócio, fontes de dados e padrões de modelagem.
  • Apoiar usuários com treinamento e habilitação para autosserviço.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias contínuas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas funcionalidades e boas práticas em Power BI.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Power BI
  • Proficiência em DAX, Power Query (M) e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com SQL e bancos relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Warehouse e ETL.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e alinhamento com áreas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas em um ambiente dinâmico.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com serviços de dados Azure (como Azure SQL e Data Factory).
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos e times multifuncionais.
  • Experiência em storytelling com dados ou governança de dados.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Senior React Native Engineer — Mobile Lead
description:
About Skip

Skip is the AI operating system for entrepreneurs. Over 1M business owners use Skip to find grants, automate tasks, build their business online, and scale faster. We’re building the next generation mobile experience that helps millions of entrepreneurs grow from their phone — and we need a world-class engineer to lead the charge.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior React Native Engineer to join our major rebuild of Skip’s mobile app (iOS + Android) and help build a consumer-grade, high-polish experience similar to Chime, Robinhood, or Coinbase — but designed for small business owners and entrepreneurs.


You’ll be one of the leads (or the main lead) for the mobile app, collaborating closely with existing engineering team, design and product, and the founder/CEO (Ryder) to ship an entirely new mobile experience from the ground up. This is a high-impact role where your work will touch hundreds of thousands of people daily.


What You’ll Do

  • Architect and rebuild Skip’s mobile app from scratch using React Native
  • Lead development of our four core tabs: Home, Discover, Workspace, and Cofounder (AI chat)
  • Implement native UI components, gesture systems, animations, and smooth navigation
  • Build high-performance chat interfaces for AI interactions
  • Integrate with Skip’s backend (Node/TS) and web tools
  • Build token-secure WebView bridges for launching web features inside native shell
  • Own performance, architecture, and long-term maintainability
  • Collaborate with product + design to move quickly and iterate
  • Ship new features weekly on a fast-moving roadmap
  • Help uplevel the engineering team and establish mobile best practices


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience with React Native
  • Strong background building and shipping consumer-grade mobile apps
  • Deep experience with animations, gesture handlers, and high-performance UI
  • Comfortable owning architecture end-to-end
  • Experience with WebViews + bridging native/web interactions
  • Strong product sense and ability to work directly with design
  • Bias toward execution — we ship fast and iterate
  • Startup mentality: scrappy, ownership-driven, and obsessed with user experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase
  • Experience with Stripe integrations
  • Experience with AI or chat-based interfaces
  • Prior startup (Series A–C) experience


Why Join Skip?

  • Help build the AI OS for millions of entrepreneurs
  • Be part of an elite, high-achieving team
  • Ship fast and own major surface area
  • Competitive salary + equity
  • Fully remote, flexible schedule
  • Big vision, fast growth, real user impact


Apply at: including why you're interested in this position and joining Skip

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor—someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.


This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.


What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.


Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).


Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.


Why Work With Mindful
  • Work with a fast-growing US-based performance agency that values craftsmanship and creativity.
  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

title: Accounting Team Lead
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an Accounting Team Lead to manage our accounting and payments processes while driving operational improvements across the company. You’ll oversee day-to-day financial operations, ensure accuracy in reporting, and identify ways to make our systems more efficient and scalable.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America


What You’ll Be Doing:


  • Oversee all aspects of accounting operations, including reconciliations, reporting, and data management
  • Manage payroll and contractor payments to ensure accuracy and timeliness
  • Supervise invoicing and Accounts Receivable processes, maintaining healthy cash flow
  • Lead the setup and optimization of tools like QuickBooks Online (QBO), Stripe, and Excel/Google Sheets for better financial visibility
  • Collaborate with leadership to design and implement process improvements and automation initiatives
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.



What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in accounting, payroll, and financial operations
  • Hands-on experience with Stripe and QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets
  • Experience with SQL, LLMs (Large Language Models), or automation tools (nice to have!)
  • Experience in fast-paced startup or SaaS environments (nice to have!)
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:


  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Hands-on experience with Stripe and QuickBooks Online (QBO)



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Comprehensive Health Coverage:

Your health is our priority. We provide access to high-quality medical insurance, ensuring you and your loved ones have the support and care you need within your country.*


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.


Service Recognition and Rewards:

Celebrate milestones with our Elite VA program, where your commitment and achievements are honored through thoughtful rewards and heartfelt appreciation.


*Please note: For hires in Latin America, health insurance is not included. Instead, we provide alternative compensation arrangements to help support your healthcare needs.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior | Node.js/TypeScript e AWS Serverless
description:
Na GrooveTech somos referência em inovação e excelência técnica no universo da tecnologia da informação. Atuamos com serviços de ITO (Information Technology Outsourcing), NOC 24x7 e Projetos Consultivos, sendo parceiros estratégicos de grandes empresas no Brasil.

Combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e foco em entregar soluções completas, eficientes e que geram impacto real nos negócios. Somos o seu time de tecnologia!


A pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior será fundamental na construção e manutenção da nossa arquitetura de microsserviços em nuvem. Buscamos um profissional com forte domínio em TypeScript/Node.js, que irá atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, com foco na lógica de aplicação e na integração de serviços.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento Core: Desenvolver e manter APIs REST utilizando NestJS, TypeScript e Go, em uma arquitetura serverless.

Persistência de Dados: Trabalhar com o banco de dados DynamoDB para persistência e modelagem de dados.

Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Construir e manter a infraestrutura AWS serverless utilizando Terraform (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, entre outros).

Arquitetura: Desenvolver soluções seguindo padrões de Clean Architecture e princípios de alta qualidade de código.

Sistemas de Eventos: Criar e integrar serviços baseados em eventos.

Testes: Implementar testes unitários e de integração utilizando Jest.

DevOps: Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Serverless Framework, GitHub e CodePipeline.

Monitoramento: Monitorar o desempenho e a saúde das aplicações utilizando DataDog e CloudWatch.

Colaboração: Participar ativamente de revisões de código e discussões técnicas de arquitetura.


Buscamos um profissional que possua:

Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor Backend.

Tecnologia e Domínio: Forte domínio em TypeScript e Node.js.

AWS Serverless: Conhecimento avançado em AWS Serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, SQS/SNS, entre outros).

IaC: Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform.

Bancos NoSQL: Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, especialmente DynamoDB.

Frameworks Serverless: Vivência com Serverless Framework.

Arquitetura: Familiaridade com padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design - DDD).

Segurança/Autenticação: Conhecimento em OAuth2/JWT e sistemas de autenticação.

Testes: Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando Jest.

Containerização: Conhecimento em Docker e containerização.

Documentação: Familiaridade com Swagger/OpenAPI para documentação de APIs.

Inglês Avançado: Para comunicação com cliente internacional.


Diferenciais

Experiência com Kafka ou outras plataformas de streaming.

Conhecimento e experiência prática em Go (Golang).

Familiaridade com Dynamoose ODM para interação com DynamoDB.

Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade via DataDog.

Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Vivência no segmento de fintech.

Conhecimento em PCI Compliance.


Informações Adicionais:

Contratação PJ

Remoto

Seguro de Vida.

Bem-Estar: Wellhub (antigo Gympass).

Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Programas de Mentoria e Desenvolvimento com nossos especialistas.

Progressão de Carreira.

description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Analista Pleno/a de Tesouraria, com atuação em nossa sede, localizada na Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP . Este/a profissional terá estas atribuições principais:


  • Realizar a gestão das operações de mútuos entre empresas do Grupo, contando com a contabilização dos juros no sistema, bem como a atualização de contratos e aditivos e consolidação em relatório;

  • Contribuir para gestão de caixa, qualificando e otimizando a programação financeira do(s) projetos(s);
  • Atuar de forma proativa na redução de custos e gestão eficiente do caixa;
  • Minimizar impactos cambiais ou de taxa de juros nas operações, seja por instrumentos de proteção ou operações financeiras;
  • Assegurar e ampliar o bom relacionamento junto as instituições financeiras, conhecendo suas particularidades, limitações e operacionalidade.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Possuir Formação Superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia e/ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência profissional pregressa com o sistema XRT será um diferencial;
  • Desejável possuir conhecimentos em Matemática Financeira, bem como noções em operações do Mercado Financeiro como Dívidas e Empréstimos;
  • Necessário possuir conhecimentos intermediários em língua inglesa;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Remote

Contract

Brazil/ Mexico


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

About Ampstek

Ampstek is a global IT solutions partner serving clients across North America, Europe, APAC, LATAM, and MEA. We specialize in delivering talent and technology solutions for enterprise-level digital transformation, trading systems, data services, and regulatory compliance.

Contact:

Desk: Ext. 125

title: Vendedor Credito Imobiliário
description:
Vaga: Consultor de Crédito – Crédito Imobiliário e Veicular | Strategy Analytics


A Strategy Analytics está ampliando sua atuação e busca Consultores Associados para originação de operações de crédito, com foco em Home Equity (garantia de imóvel) e Auto Equity (garantia de veículo), além de outros produtos financeiros.

A atuação é autônoma (PJ) , exigindo carteira própria de clientes e perfil comercial disciplinado.

Profissionais qualificados poderão ser integrados ao time interno, com acesso à estrutura física, veículos corporativos e capacitações avançadas.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar com carteira de clientes própria já ativa.

• Prospectar novos clientes e ampliar relacionamento.

• Ofertar Home Equity, Auto Equity e demais soluções financeiras.

• Executar atendimento consultivo, focado em relacionamento e fidelização.

• Cumprir metas de conversão e constância comercial.

• Subir e organizar todos os documentos no OneDrive corporativo , seguindo a estrutura:

– Tipo de Crédito

– Cliente

– Tipo de Documento (pessoais, imóvel, veículo, bancários etc.)

Após a organização no OneDrive, a equipe Administrativa assume o processo, realiza conferências, acompanha bancos/parceiros e mantém o Consultor atualizado sobre cada etapa do cliente.


Requisitos

• Carteira ativa de clientes (obrigatório).

• CNPJ ativo (ou disponibilidade para abrir MEI).

• Experiência prévia com crédito ou vendas financeiras.

• Notebook, celular e internet estável.

• Perfil organizado, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com Home Equity, Auto Equity ou produtos correlatos.

• Histórico de alta performance em vendas.

• Domínio de CRM, gestão de pipeline e organização documental.


Regras de Aceite – Home Equity

Aceitos

• Crédito de R$ 50 mil a R$ 3 milhões.

• Imóveis a partir de R$ 150 mil.

• Imóvel no nome do cliente ou parente de 1º grau.

• Casas, apartamentos, sobrados, terrenos urbanos e imóveis comerciais averbados.

• Financiamento ativo aceito (mínimo 50% quitado).

• Renda mínima de R$ 4 mil.

Aceitos com regularização

• Sem averbação → Habite-se + CND INSS.

• Sem averbação de compra e venda → Escritura + ITBI.

• Imóvel em construção → apenas o terreno será considerado.

Não aceitos

• Imóveis rurais, galpões, áreas industriais.

• Imóveis irregulares, igrejas, escolas, hospitais.

• Imóveis com risco ambiental.


Regras de Aceite – Auto Equity

Aceitos

• Crédito entre R$ 5 mil e R$ 150 mil.

• Veículos leves.

• Até 17 anos de fabricação (blindados até 6 anos; PcD até 5 anos).

• Veículo no nome do cliente ou parente até 3º grau.

• Financiamento ativo aceito (mínimo 20% quitado).

Não aceitos

• Veículos pesados.

• Sem possibilidade de transferência.

• Veículos em nome de terceiros fora do grau permitido.

• PJ contratante.


Modelo de Trabalho

• Regime: PJ

• Formato: Remoto

• Comissão:

– Home Equity: 3% fixo por operação concluída

– Auto Equity: Percentuais conforme conversão do parceiro, já no valor final recebido pelo Consultor:

Auto Equity – Percentuais finais do Consultor Associado

• Conversão abaixo de 1,50% → 1,5%

• Conversão entre 1,50% e 2,50% → 2%
