title: AI Technical Manager / Product Owner | USD $70k-90k
description:
We are seeking an AI-focused Technical Manager / Product Owner to lead delivery for multiple AI initiatives. This role blends product ownership, delivery management, and AI-savvy stakeholder leadership. You’ll own outcomes, organize work for fast iteration, manage expectations with demanding business and technology partners, and collaborate closely with an AI Architect and engineering leads to turn AI opportunities into clear, shippable increments.

You are comfortable moving at a high tempo, getting to the point quickly, and keeping teams and stakeholders aligned while AI projects evolve rapidly.


Key Responsibilities
  • Translate ambiguous AI-related business goals into clear problem statements, prioritized backlogs, and sequenced delivery plans.
  • Own the order of work: define MVP, prioritize by impact and effort, and ensure the first outcomes are meaningful and measurable.
  • Manage expectations with business, technical, and partner stakeholders (including large cloud/enterprise partners) around scope, tradeoffs, and timelines.
  • Act as POPM/PO across one or two concurrent AI projects, maintaining visibility, momentum, and alignment.
  • Collaborate with an AI Architect and engineering leads to align business outcomes with technical implementation, without needing to be a hands-on developer.
  • Facilitate Sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives with a focus on outcomes, learning, and velocity rather than ceremony.
  • Anticipate risks and issues ahead of time rather than reacting late; surface them clearly and propose actionable options.
  • Ensure that business outcomes, user value, and AI capabilities are consistently connected and understood by all parties.
  • Maintain strong executive presence in meetings: concise updates, clear decisions, and structured communication.
  • Support scale-up of AI delivery by helping define patterns, governance, and ways-of-working that can be reused across projects.


Required Skills
  • Experience as a Product Owner, POPM, or Technical Delivery Manager in software or AI-enabled projects.
  • Hands-on experience delivering AI or data-driven products (e.g., LLM-enabled features, analytics/BI flows, intelligent workflows), with enough familiarity to reason about what’s possible and how to get there.
  • Strong backlog management skills: writing/structuring user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and ordering work to hit early wins.
  • Proven ability to manage expectations and lead tradeoff conversations with senior stakeholders.
  • High-tempo, high-ownership working style: you move quickly while staying organized and predictable.
  • Clear, concise, and structured communication (problem → options → decision → outcome).
  • Ability to work closely with architects/engineers, understand their constraints, and keep technical and business sides aligned.
  • Comfort working across multiple parallel initiatives and adjusting priorities as new information emerges.


Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Prior experience working with or alongside major cloud vendors or large enterprise partners.
  • Experience in consulting, agency, or multi-client delivery environments.
  • Exposure to OKRs or similar outcome-based planning frameworks.
  • Experience in AI-heavy environments where the technology and partner landscape change quickly.

title: Engenheiro de Dados |  Scala • Databricks
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

Buscamos um profissional com foco em Engenharia de Dados , que possua background em desenvolvimento backend , especialmente com Node.js, Scala e Databricks , para atuar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto tecnológico.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em Scala, preferencialmente e Databricks.
  • Experiência prática em Node.js, com foco em microserviços e APIs REST.
  • Vivência em engenharia de dados, especialmente com stream processing e integração entre sistemas.

  • Experiência com Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD e boas práticas de versionamento.
  • Domínio de DDD, TDD e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Perfil colaborativo, analítico e foco em resultados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de engenharia de dados e integração de grandes volumes de informação.

  • Criar e evoluir serviços backend e APIs em Node.js, integrando-os a fluxos de dados e aplicações financeiras.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelos de dados em bancos relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server).
  • Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados utilizando Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Automatizar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (Azure), configurando recursos e monitorando performance.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de engenharia, produto e dados para garantir escalabilidade, segurança e performance das soluções.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics

  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice


Why joining ERA Group?

This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

  • Integration Procedure
  • Data Raptor
  • Omniscript
  • FlexCard
  • Calculation Matrices
  • Validation Rule
  • Flow
  • Profile
  • Lightning Page
  • Role
  • Apex
  • LWC


Skill Set:

  • Omni Studio Proficiency: Strong experience with Omni Studio tools, including OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards.
  • Salesforce Development: Proficiency in Apex programming, Visualforce pages, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Declarative Tools: Expertise in using Salesforce's declarative tools for customization.
  • Integration Skills: Experience with Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Testing: Ability to write comprehensive test cases and perform various testing methods.
  • Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Deployment: Experience with deployment methodologies and tools like Salesforce DX.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Agile Methodology: Understanding of Agile development practices.
  • Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current with Salesforce features and updates.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Patch Manager (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.

  • Experience planning, deploying, and validating patches across servers and endpoints.
  • Ability to interpret vulnerability scan results (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) and prioritize remediation.
  • Skilled at assessing patch criticality, handling exceptions, and applying compensating controls when needed.
  • Familiar with change management, maintenance windows, and ITIL-based processes.
  • Understanding of Windows/Linux systems, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and basic networking concepts.
  • Awareness of patching considerations in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Possibility of working remotely;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • Lounge;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • Coffee and varied snacks at your disposal;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


We will use personal information that you have sent us to consider your application for the relevant function. By giving us your information/documents by email, you consent to Aubay Portugal treating your personal information. Your privacy is important to us. Please check our Privacy Policy, which explains how we will use and store your personal information. It also explains the rights you have regarding your information and how you can contact us for clarification of questions or requests.

title: IT Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Role: IT APM Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate

Duration: 12+ Months


We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer to support our enterprise architecture and application rationalization efforts using LeanIX. This role is critical in capturing, analyzing, and maintaining application metadata to assess current technology usage, align future business requirements, and guide decisions on modernization, consolidation, or new application development. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil.


Why This Role Matters:

This role directly supports our enterprise-wide transformation by enabling smarter technology investments, reducing redundancy, and aligning IT capabilities with business strategy. You’ll play a key role in shaping our future application landscape.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

LeanIX Data Stewardship

  • Populate and maintain accurate application data within LeanIX, including ownership, lifecycle, business capabilities, and technical attributes.
  • Ensure completeness and consistency of metadata across the application portfolio.


Application Rationalization

  • Evaluate applications for business value (e.g., strategic alignment, user impact, cost efficiency).
  • Assess technical value (e.g., scalability, integration readiness, security posture, supportability).
  • Identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or modernization.


Technology Mapping & Future Planning

  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to map future business requirements to existing technologies.
  • Support decision-making on whether to enhance current platforms or build new applications.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with application owners, enterprise architects, and business analysts to gather insights and validate data.
  • Facilitate workshops and reviews to ensure alignment on application strategy and lifecycle decisions.


Reporting & Insights

  • Generate dashboards and reports from LeanIX to support executive decision-making.
  • Provide insights into portfolio health, redundancy, risk, and optimization opportunities.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in application portfolio management, enterprise architecture, or IT asset management.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanIX or similar APM tools.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, business capability modeling, and technology stack analysis.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is required.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.

The application window is short , so if this sounds like something you’d like to explore, let’s set up a quick chat today!

title: Especialista Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


Oportunidade: Especialista Azure

A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataforma Microsoft Azure . A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase em Azure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.


Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
  • Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
  • Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou ExpressRoute.
  • Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
  • Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
  • Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio comprovado em Azure Network (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
  • Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
  • Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
  • Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.


Contratação CLT

Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.


O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).


  • Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Python Developer
description:
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética.

Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


Oportunidade: Especialista Azure

A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataforma Microsoft Azure . A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase em Azure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.


Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
  • Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
  • Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou ExpressRoute.
  • Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
  • Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
  • Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio comprovado em Azure Network (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
  • Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
  • Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
  • Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.


Contratação CLT

Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.


O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Back End Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract: 12/01/2025 to 02/28/2026 (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Order Pricing team, responsible for building and enhancing the Pricing applications that define, manage, and apply promotions across the shopping experience. This role focuses on developing high-performance backend systems that ensure accurate, real-time pricing and promotion application to shopping bags.

Consultant will play a key role in designing scalable microservices, implementing event-driven architecture, and driving continuous delivery in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Backend System Design & Development: Architect, develop, and maintain microservices in Java and Spring Boot to support pricing, promotions setup, and calculation logic.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Design and maintain asynchronous data flows using Apache Kafka for high throughput and reliability in real-time promotion processing.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment: Build and deploy services on Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, resilience, and observability across environments.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Develop and maintain automated build and deploy pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and Argo CD, ensuring fast, reliable, and secure delivery.
  • Performance & Reliability: Optimize services for high performance and low latency, including caching strategies, database tuning, and message processing efficiency.
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Implement observability and operational monitoring using GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana to ensure system health, proactive alerting, and incident response.


Requirements:

  • Experience: 6–10 years of professional experience in backend software development, preferably within e-commerce, retail, or pricing systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Java 11+ and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
  • Proven experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, topics, schema registry, error handling, and message tracing).
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on Kubernetes.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and ArgoCD
  • Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching (Redis).
  • Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Azure.
  • Experience with GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana for monitoring, alerting, and incident management.
  • Understanding of distributed tracing and log correlation best practices.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Apply now or reach out directly for more details.

title: Video Editor
description:
Are you a creative storyteller who knows how to turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, lead-generating, emotionally powerful video content? Do you love crafting videos that educate, inspire, and convert? If yes, we want you on our team.


Bueno Law, a purpose-driven immigration law firm, is expanding our marketing team, and we’re looking for an exceptional video editor to enhance and elevate our content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.


Your videos will play a key role in helping people find the help they need — while driving lead traffic and brand visibility.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


You’ll be responsible for transforming raw footage into polished, high-impact videos that capture attention and keep viewers engaged.


Your work will include:


Editing dynamic video content such as:


  • Explainer & educational videos


  • Client success stories / testimonials


  • FAQ/Q&A content


  • Live consultation clips & tips


  • Motion graphics or animated support videos


  • Short-form reels for Instagram/Facebook/YouTube Shorts


  • YouTube long-form content


Core Editing Responsibilities


  • Turn raw footage into fully polished, professional content


  • Add intros, outros, subtitles, lower thirds & graphic elements


  • Add transitions, music, and sound design to elevate storytelling


  • Create engaging thumbnail concepts


  • Ensure all videos match brand identity, tone, and quality standards


  • Optimize all content for each platform (length, pacing, hooks, formatting)


  • Take feedback with a positive mindset and implement revisions quickly


  • Collaborate closely with our marketing team to bring ideas to life


WHAT YOU BRING


We’re looking for someone who is creative, dependable, and takes pride in delivering exceptional work.


Must-Have Requirements


  • English fluency


  • Proven experience editing videos for YouTube & social media


  • A strong portfolio showcasing previous work


  • Expert-level proficiency in editing apps


  • Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, and visual branding


  • Ability to meet consistent deadlines (quality + speed)


  • Highly detail-oriented and able to notice small mistakes before publishing


  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating with a team


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US


  • Competitive compensation


  • Fully remote work environment


  • Quarterly performance bonuses


  • Paid time off + U.S. holidays


  • Your work will help us change the lives of thousands of immigrants in the U.S.


HOW TO APPLY


Please send us via email to


  • Your portfolio or links to videos you have edited (YouTube links preferred)
  • A brief note about why you’re a great fit
  • Your resume/ curriculum vitae


Email subject line: Video Editor Application – (Your Name)

title: Video Editor
description:
Are you a creative storyteller who knows how to turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, lead-generating, emotionally powerful video content? Do you love crafting videos that educate, inspire, and convert? If yes, we want you on our team.


Bueno Law, a purpose-driven immigration law firm, is expanding our marketing team, and we’re looking for an exceptional video editor to enhance and elevate our content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.


Your videos will play a key role in helping people find the help they need — while driving lead traffic and brand visibility.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


You’ll be responsible for transforming raw footage into polished, high-impact videos that capture attention and keep viewers engaged.


Your work will include:


Editing dynamic video content such as:


  • Explainer & educational videos


  • Client success stories / testimonials


  • FAQ/Q&A content


  • Live consultation clips & tips


  • Motion graphics or animated support videos


  • Short-form reels for Instagram/Facebook/YouTube Shorts


  • YouTube long-form content


Core Editing Responsibilities


  • Turn raw footage into fully polished, professional content


  • Add intros, outros, subtitles, lower thirds & graphic elements


  • Add transitions, music, and sound design to elevate storytelling


  • Create engaging thumbnail concepts


  • Ensure all videos match brand identity, tone, and quality standards


  • Optimize all content for each platform (length, pacing, hooks, formatting)


  • Take feedback with a positive mindset and implement revisions quickly


  • Collaborate closely with our marketing team to bring ideas to life


WHAT YOU BRING


We’re looking for someone who is creative, dependable, and takes pride in delivering exceptional work.


Must-Have Requirements


  • English fluency


  • Proven experience editing videos for YouTube & social media


  • A strong portfolio showcasing previous work


  • Expert-level proficiency in editing apps


  • Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, and visual branding


  • Ability to meet consistent deadlines (quality + speed)


  • Highly detail-oriented and able to notice small mistakes before publishing


  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating with a team


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US


  • Competitive compensation


  • Fully remote work environment


  • Quarterly performance bonuses


  • Paid time off + U.S. holidays


  • Your work will help us change the lives of thousands of immigrants in the U.S.


HOW TO APPLY


Please send us via email to


  • Your portfolio or links to videos you have edited (YouTube links preferred)
  • A brief note about why you’re a great fit
  • Your resume/ curriculum vitae


Email subject line: Video Editor Application – (Your Name)

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Description


C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm dedicated to helping B2B organizations address capability and capacity challenges across go-to-market and revenue operations. We specialize in building outbound-led growth systems that turn buying intent into scalable revenue through data-driven processes and accountability. Collaborating with clients ranging from startups to enterprises, we focus on creating financially sustainable growth while exceeding pipeline and revenue goals. Our team offers hands-on support across the full revenue cycle, including go-to-market strategies, demand generation, pipeline management, and revenue operations with CRM integration and reporting.

The Executive Assistant will handle a range of administrative duties, including executive support, managing expense reports, scheduling meetings, organizing calendars, and providing general administrative assistance. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Nosso Cliente

Cliente global de tecnologia, com presença no Brasil e em diversos setores industriais. Esta vaga está sendo divulgada como banco de talentos para uma demanda prevista para os próximos meses.

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares)
  • Autonomia para execução técnica (nível pleno ou superior)
  • Idioma: inglês poderá ser exigido dependendo do projeto. Ter inglês é um diferencial e será considerado na priorização conforme a demanda.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência em arquitetura, componentes reutilizáveis e governança
  • Atuação em projetos globais ou times internacionais
  • Conhecimento em .NET, C#, SQL, front-end ou microserviços

  • Experiência em liderança técnica, mentoria ou suporte a outros devs
  • Inglês para conversação, reuniões e documentação técnica

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist (LATAM) — Remote
description:
Join GrowthAssistant as a Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist!

Open to candidates from LATAM countries only (e.g., Mexico, Brazil, Colombia)


About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist to support our client’s Paid Media team. You’ll ensure every digital advertising campaign is tracked accurately and consistently, building and maintaining the infrastructure behind performance measurement. This includes configuring, QA’ing, and troubleshooting tracking systems—mainly via Google Tag Manager (GTM)—to ensure data integrity and accurate attribution.


By partnering closely with Paid Search Specialists and Account Strategists, you’ll help eliminate inaccurate conversion data, improve ROI reporting, and enable smarter optimization decisions across 60+ client accounts.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Implement, QA, and maintain tags, triggers, and pixels in Google Tag Manager (GTM) across client websites.
  • Audit and troubleshoot conversion tracking configurations across platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads).
  • Validate conversion actions to ensure form fills, purchases, or other lead events are correctly recorded, avoiding inflated reporting.
  • Standardize and document tagging schemas for all client accounts in Salesforce, ensuring consistent fields (budget, KPIs, goals, tracking status).
  • Partner with Paid Search Specialists to align conversion actions and budgets with each client’s true business objectives.
  • Create and maintain a tracking QA checklist and intake form to guide new account setups and audits.
  • Perform ongoing health checks of all tracking infrastructure to proactively identify broken tags or discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the client’s marketing team to recommend scalable intake and QA processes (e.g., onboarding forms, Salesforce automation).
  • Produce clear documentation for all tagging and data validation processes to ensure team-wide continuity.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience managing Google Tag Manager (tag creation, testing, triggers, version control).
  • Solid understanding of conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid media platforms.
  • Hands-on experience validating data layers, debugging tags, and testing event triggers in browser consoles.
  • Strong ability to QA campaign tracking and identify discrepancies between actual and reported performance data.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or maintaining documentation (SOPs, QA templates, checklists).
  • Excellent communication skills to partner with account managers, strategists, and technical teams.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems for marketing data management.
  • Understanding of enhanced conversions, consent mode, and privacy-related tagging.
  • Exposure to GA4 or other analytics platforms for event-based measurement.
  • Experience supporting agencies managing high-volume client portfolios.
  • Prior experience collaborating with web developers or marketing analysts on data validation and tag troubleshooting.


Durable Skills

  • Highly detail-oriented, precise, and methodical in QA and documentation.
  • Process-driven mindset—capable of building repeatable tagging and validation frameworks.
  • Problem-solving mentality with a focus on scalable solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ownership mentality with a focus on accuracy, quality, and reliability.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Habilidades Principais:

Profissional sênior com forte atuação no desenvolvimento de soluções Salesforce, capaz de criar, customizar e manter aplicações nas clouds da plataforma seguindo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, governança e arquitetura.   • Inglês avançado
  • Desenvolvimento Salesforce completo : Apex, Visualforce, Lightning (Aura e LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Web Services, Batch, Triggers, Test Classes, Flows e recursos OOB.

  • Construção de soluções customizadas ou utilizando configuração padrão sempre buscando reduzir necessidade de código.
  • Manutenção e suporte da instância Salesforce .
  • Conhecimento forte em tecnologias web : JavaScript, HTML5, CSS.
  • Controle de versão : Git, Bitbucket, Visual Studio, IntelliJ ou similares.
  • Integrações : REST, Data Loader, Import Wizard, Postman.
  • Arquitetura e boas práticas : OOP, MVCS, Domain Layer, padrões de projeto.
  • Documentação técnica : protótipos, diagramas, especificações de solução.
  • Atuação colaborativa com usuários-chave, arquitetos e consultores, incluindo demonstrações e validações.
  • Revisão de código e garantia de qualidade com criação de planos e critérios de teste.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Sobre a LoopGlobal
A LoopGlobal é um ecossistema industrial formado por quatro pilares estratégicos:
LoopZero – Engenharia, simulação de processos (MAGMASOFT), desenvolvimento de projetos e soluções avançadas para moldes e injeção.
LoopParts – Comercialização de máquinas e equipamentos para fundição de alumínio, injeção, automação e usinagem.
LoopService – Assistência técnica, start-up, manutenção e otimização de células de injeção.
LoopAcademy – Treinamentos técnicos e capacitação profissional para fundição e injeção de metais.

Elaborar propostas técnicas e comerciais de máquinas, células completas e soluções de automação.
Realizar apresentações técnicas e reuniões com tomadores de decisão.
Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, margens e projeções comerciais.

Compreender processos de injeção de alumínio (alta pressão).
Interpretar desenhos, projetos e necessidades de células de produção.
Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e soluções customizadas.

Participar de start-ups, FATs e visitas técnicas quando necessário.

Conhecimento em equipamentos como:
Injetoras de alumínio
Fornos
Robôs e automações
Periféricos (dosadoras, termorreguladores, rebarbadores, etc.)

Noções de automação industrial (robôs, sensores, manipuladores, células).
Conhecimento de processos: dosagem, ciclo de injeção, extração, resfriamento, metalurgia.

Comunicação consultiva.

Autonomia para visitas e viagens.

Treinamentos pela LoopAcademy.
Oportunidade de atuar com marcas de referência em máquinas e tecnologias.
Crescimento estruturado dentro do ecossistema LoopGlobal.

Buscamos alguém técnico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, que domine o ambiente de chão de fábrica e saiba transformar conhecimento técnico em soluções comerciais de alto valor agregado.

title: Profissional .NET Sênior com Inglês
description:
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência com C# e .NET/Core;

- Domínio de bancos de dados Oracle e SQL Server, incluindo criação de procedures, views e otimização de consultas;

- Vivência com Windows Forms para manutenção e evolução de aplicações legadas;

- Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful;

- Conhecimento sólido em programação orientada a objetos e aplicação de princípios SOLID;

- Prática com padrões de design (Design Patterns);

- Utilização de GIT para versionamento e controle de código-fonte;

- Conhecimento em frameworks front-end modernos, como React e Angular, desejável;

- Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação técnica;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Search Engine Marketing Strategist
description:
Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (Search Engine Marketing Strategist) WPP Media Studio – Divisão de E-Commerce

Meio período · Trabalho remoto

Uma Marca Fundada em Inovação, Confiança e Crescimento Sustentável

Na WPP Media Studio , acreditamos no poder do marketing digital para gerar conexões reais e duradouras. Nosso compromisso com a excelência e inovação nos permite ajudar marcas globais a alcançar seus objetivos, maximizando o impacto e a relevância no mundo digital.

Com uma visão focada em estratégias de longo prazo e baseadas em dados, somos movidos pelo propósito de oferecer soluções eficazes e resultados consistentes. Nossa missão é criar experiências digitais que transformam marcas e conectam empresas com seus consumidores de maneira significativa.

Agora, para fortalecer nossa equipe de marketing digital, estamos em busca de um Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (SEM) altamente qualificado. Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por resultados, com uma visão estratégica e foco em performance, queremos que você se junte a nós para construir o futuro do marketing de busca e e-commerce.

Por que esta função é importante?

O marketing de busca é uma das pedras angulares das estratégias de marketing digital, especialmente no e-commerce. Como Estratégista de Marketing de Busca , você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEM (Search Engine Marketing) que impulsionam o tráfego, aumentam a visibilidade da marca e, acima de tudo, geram conversões para nossos clientes.

Esta função é essencial porque:

  • Impulsiona a visibilidade digital e o tráfego qualificado para as marcas com as quais trabalhamos
  • Maximiza o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) de campanhas de mídia paga através de otimizações contínuas
  • Gerencia e executa campanhas de Google Ads, Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca , garantindo máxima eficiência
  • Contribui diretamente para a estratégia de e-commerce , gerando resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis

Seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no crescimento e no sucesso contínuo de nossos clientes no universo digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Estratégias SEM

  • Criar estratégias eficazes para campanhas de Google Ads , Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca
  • Gerenciar a execução e otimização de campanhas de SEM, focando em aquisição de tráfego e conversões
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave , análise da concorrência e monitoramento de tendências de mercado

Otimização de Desempenho

  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente campanhas com o objetivo de melhorar o CPC (Custo por Clique) , CTR (Taxa de Clique) e ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento)
  • Utilizar dados de Google Analytics e outras ferramentas analíticas para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas
  • Conduzir testes A/B para aprimorar a performance das campanhas e o conteúdo dos anúncios

Análise e Relatórios

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o desempenho das campanhas e fornecer insights acionáveis aos clientes
  • Traduzir dados e métricas de desempenho em recomendações claras para ajustes nas campanhas
  • Monitorar a configuração de pixels de rastreamento , ações de conversão e outras métricas relevantes

Colaboração e Comunicação

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes de criatividade , conteúdo e e-commerce para garantir a consistência da marca e a eficácia das campanhas
  • Manter uma comunicação aberta com os clientes, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das campanhas
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de busca com foco em Google Ads e Bing Ads
  • Sólido conhecimento de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) e SEM (Search Engine Marketing)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e outras ferramentas de monitoramento de desempenho
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e fazer ajustes para melhorar resultados de campanhas
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente com um alto nível de precisão e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes
  • Trabalho remoto com autonomia e alta responsabilidade
Experiência Preferencial

(Não obrigatória, mas será um diferencial)

  • Experiência com plataformas de publicidade programática e remarketing
  • Certificações avançadas em Google Ads e Microsoft Advertising
  • Conhecimento de otimização da taxa de conversão (CRO) e criação de páginas de destino eficazes
  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce e em campanhas digitais que geram receita
Benefícios e Cultura de Trabalho

Na WPP Media Studio , nossa cultura se baseia na confiança, transparência e no trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que nossos colaboradores devem ter o espaço e a flexibilidade para prosperar. Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto flexível : você poderá trabalhar de qualquer lugar, com horários flexíveis
  • Crescimento profissional contínuo : oportunidades para aprimorar suas habilidades e influenciar a estratégia de marketing digital
  • Ambiente colaborativo : uma equipe dinâmica e engajada que trabalha com sinergia para alcançar os melhores resultados
  • Foco no impacto : trabalhamos para gerar valor real para nossos clientes e construir parcerias de longo prazo
  • Cultura missionária : nosso compromisso é sempre com a qualidade, inovação e resultados sustentáveis
  • Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o impacto real que nossos colaboradores fazem na transformação digital de nossos clientes.

title: Desenvolvedor Python Pleno
description:
A automatizAI está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python Pleno para integrar nosso time de tecnologia em um projeto estratégico de validação de contratos jurídicos.


Sobre o Projeto:

Você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de um sistema para avaliação e validação de contratos jurídicos entre filiais e matriz. O sistema automatizará todo o fluxo de análise contratual, trazendo desafios técnicos interessantes como a identificação inteligente de documentos enviados e validação automática baseada em regras de negócio estabelecidas, utilizando inteligência artificial e processamento de linguagem natural.


Responsabilidades:

* Desenvolver, manter aplicações e automações em Python

* Criar e integrar APIs e microserviços

* Implementar soluções com LLMs (via OpenRouter)

* Trabalhar com Supabase (PostgreSQL) e Redis

* Colaborar com o time na definição de arquiteturas e boas práticas


Requisitos:

* Experiência sólida com Python e testes unitários

* Conhecimento em FastAPI ou Flask

* Experiência com o uso de AI Coding Assistant

* Vivência com bancos de dados SQL e cache (Redis será um diferencial)

* Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e proativa


Diferenciais:

* Experiência com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)

* Conhecimento em Railway ou plataformas similares de deploy

* Experiência com processamento de documentos (PDF, OCR, etc.)


Informações da Contratação:

* Contratação: PJ

* Duração inicial: 9 meses (com possibilidade de extensão)

* Modelo: 100% Remoto

* Dedicação: Exclusiva ao projeto

* Salário: Até 8k


Se você tem raciocínio lógico forte, gosta de resolver problemas complexos e quer trabalhar com tecnologias modernas de IA, essa oportunidade é para você!

title: Learning Management System Administrator
description:
About NIIT


At NIIT, we’re transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That’s why the world’s best-run learning functions across 30 countries trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high-impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

Job Title: Senior Training Coordinator (SuccessFactors)


Job Overview:


We are seeking an LMS Analyst with basic experience in SAP SuccessFactors to support our LMS team in optimizing our human resource processes. The ideal candidate will assist with system configuration, data management, and reporting, contributing to the overall effectiveness of our LMS operations.


Key Responsibilities:


  • · Assist in the administration and configuration of SuccessFactors modules, including Employee Central, Performance & Goals, and Learning Management.
  • · Have a Consultative approach towards LMS Management by providing improvement ideas and suggestions
  • · Support data entry, data management, and data integrity within the SuccessFactors system.
  • · Generate standard and ad-hoc reports to analyze LMS metrics and support decision-making.
  • · Collaborate with LMS team members to streamline processes and improve user experience within the system.
  • · Participate in user training sessions and provide support to end-users as needed.
  • · Help troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with IT or SuccessFactors support for resolution.


Qualifications:


  • · Basic understanding of SAP SuccessFactors, with experience in one or more modules preferred.
  • · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • · Familiarity with LMS processes and practices is a plus.
  • · Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.


Education:


  • · Bachelor’s degree in any stream, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience:
  • · Previous experience in LMS or LMSIS support is a plus, but not required.
  • Work Environment:
  • · This position may be remote or in-office, depending on company policy.
  • Additional Information:
  • · Opportunities for training and professional development in SuccessFactors and other LMS technologies.
  • This description provides a foundational understanding of what might be expected from someone with basic SuccessFactors experience in an LMS role.


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. *

title: SAP SAC Developer
description:
